title: Risk Control Specialist (Evening shift)
description:
About BingX

  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018
  • With 20 million registered users worldwide
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified
  • List over 1,000 spot trading pairs
  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs
  • Integrate with over 80 public chain ecosystems
  • Rank top on CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko
  • TradingView's Best Crypto Exchange for 2021, 2022 & 2023
  • A gateway for the next billion crypto users


Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 20 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Full-time | Long-term | REMOTE


Responsibilities

  • Conduct user audits on the company's risk control platform
  • Monitor for and promptly respond to any abnormal transaction data, making judgments as necessary
  • Continually learn about the platform's rules and enhance personal and professional skills
  • Keep abreast of external competitors' changes in risk control rules and provide suggestions based on current regulations


Requirements

  • At least 1 year of working experience in risk control/transaction monitoring/customer support
  • Possess business sensitivity and awareness of risk
  • Strong psychological quality with effective communication and judgment skills
  • Strong logical thinking and data collection and analysis abilities
  • Strict adherence to professional ethics and information security and confidentiality in daily work
  • Work Schedule: 12:00 PM – 8:00 PM (Brazil Time)


Working at BingX

  • Join an international and diversified team
  • Great career development in a fast-growing company
  • Be part of the future of finance technology and achieve meaningful goals
  • Competitive market salary and fully remote/work-from-home flexibility
  • Flexibility to observe your local holiday calendar, alongside additional benefits

title: Software Engineer
description:
Job Title: Mid‑Level Software Developer (Product Team) — Azure AKS

Job Location: REMOTE - Nearshore

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years professional software development experience.
  • Strong proficiency in one or more of: .NET/C#, Java, or Node.js for building RESTful services.
  • Practical experience with Docker and deploying workloads to Azure AKS (Deployments, Services, Ingress, namespaces).
  • CI/CD experience (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions) and infrastructure automation (Helm/Kustomize; familiarity with Terraform/Bicep a plus).
  • Cloud security and configuration: Azure AD workload identity, Key Vault, App Configuration, secrets management, least privilege.
  • Observability: hands‑on with logs/metrics/traces (Azure Monitor; familiarity with Prometheus/Grafana welcomed).
  • Working knowledge of Agile practices and collaborative delivery in cross‑functional product teams.

title: Técnico eletrônico
description:
Buscamos TÉCNICO ELETRÔNICO para trabalhar presencialmente em Cachoeirinha/RS

Salário compatível com o mercado baseado nas competências e experiência profissional comprovada, salário entre R$ 2.200,00 (iniciante) até R$ 2.500,00 (pelo menos 2 anos de experiência).

A Schalter é uma empresa fabricante de produtos eletrônicos, também com atuação no segmento da tecnologia da informação, mais especificamente provedora de produtos, serviços e soluções tecnológicas integradas de automação comercial, bancária, industrial e de informática.

Nossa experiência de 34 anos de atuação nos permitiu obter conhecimento e credibilidade para oferecer soluções customizadas para empresas de diversos setores e que se encontram em diferentes estágios de desenvolvimento e porte.

Venha se juntar à nossa equipe, esta pode ser a tua oportunidade se você deseja construir um futuro sólido, sustentável e desenvolver sua carreira.

Principais atividades e responsabilidades

O “Técnico Eletrônico” desempenha um papel fundamental na para manter a linha de produção em funcionamento de maneira eficiente. Suas principais atividades e responsabilidades incluem:

  • Executar a instalação e a manutenção de componentes, sistemas eletrônicos e equipamentos
  • Cooperação com a Equipe de Produção, montagem, manutenção, testes e embalagem de produtos a serem expedidos para clientes
  • Resolução de problemas de produtos e componentes
  • Participar do desenvolvimento de projetos
  • Realizar medições e testes com componentes eletrônicos
  • Executar procedimentos de controle de qualidade

Habilidades desejáveis

  • Proatividade
  • Comunicativo, boa dicção
  • Dinâmico
  • Foco no resultado e obtenção de metas estabelecidas
  • Visão Analítica
  • Agir com equilíbrio emocional
  • Trabalhar com ética
  • A capacidade de trabalhar bem em equipe
  • Ser detalhista aos processos e registros

Requisitos mínimos para o cargo

  • Desejado Curso Técnico em Eletrônica, mecânica ou Informática
  • Conhecimento técnico na solução de problemas em reparos de equipamentos.

Requisitos desejável para o cargo

  • No mínimo 1 ano de experiência

Benefícios:

  • Salário compatível com o mercado baseado nas competências e experiência profissional (Faixa salaria entre R$ 2.200,00 (iniciante) até R$ 2.500,00 (pelo menos 2 anos de experiência)
  • VT: De acordo com itinerário (Exclusivamente se usar transporte público, mediante regras de vale transporte de acordo com CLT)
  • VR
  • Plano de saúde ambulatorial e odonto após contrato de experiência
  • PPLR
  • Day OFF: Dia de folga como prémio para comemoração do aniversário conforme política definida pela empresa

Tipo de emprego

  • Vinculo: CLT
  • Formato: Presencial - 44 horas semanais
  • Jornada: Segunda a quinta-feira das 08:00 as 12:30 e das 13:30 as 18:00, Sexta-feira das 08:00 as 12:30 e das 13:30 as 17:00
  • Local de trabalho: Avenida Frederico Augusto Ritter, 520, Cachoeirinha, RS, BR

Setor

  • Área produtiva, se reporta para o gestor da Produção.

Tipo de emprego

  • Tempo integral

Contrato de experiência

  • 90 (noventa) dias

title: Guest Services Coordinator
description:
We are partnering with a global corporate housing provider to recruit a Guest Services Coordinator for a fully remote position, open to candidates based in Argentina or Brazil.


This full-time role is suited to a service-driven professional with strong communication skills and experience within guest services, relocation, or a fast-paced customer service environment. The successful candidate will support end-to-end guest experiences, ensuring high service standards are maintained at all times.


Responsibilities:

  • Act as the primary point of contact for guests throughout their temporary accommodation stay.
  • Manage and resolve guest-reported maintenance and service issues promptly and professionally.
  • Process client extension requests accurately and efficiently.
  • Deliver a consistently high level of customer service with strong attention to detail.
  • Assist with the preparation and delivery of monthly guest services reports.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and support implementation initiatives.
  • Issue move-out instructions and extension notices as required.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of in-house guest issues within internal systems.
  • Participate in an out-of-hours emergency phone rota to manage urgent guest matters.
  • Communicate clearly, professionally, and empathetically via phone and email with guests and internal teams.
  • Work collaboratively while managing responsibilities independently in a remote setting.


Requirements:

  • Previous experience in guest services, relocation, corporate housing, hotel/hospitality or a related customer service role is highly desirable.
  • Ability to remain calm and solution-focused in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Strong IT proficiency, particularly Microsoft Word and Excel.
  • Professional, customer-focused approach with a commitment to service excellence.
  • Highly organised, self-motivated, and comfortable working remotely.

title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:

Job Description:

We are seeking a motivated DevOps Engineer to support our cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines in a dynamic environment leveraging Kubernetes, AWS, GCP, Postgres, and Terraform. In this role, you will participate in automating infrastructure provisioning, managing containerized applications, and maintaining CI/CD workflows to ensure smooth and scalable deployments. You will work closely with senior engineers to troubleshoot issues, implement best practices, and enhance system reliability and performance across multi-cloud platforms. This is an excellent opportunity to grow your skills in a fast-paced, collaborative DevOps environment.

This contract position is open to remote candidates outside the United States in North/South America and will report to the Sr. Manager of DevOps Engineering.

What you get to do every day:

-Participate in an on-call rotation on a regular basis and respond to incidents reliably and professionally.

-Maintain and evolve our AWS cloud infrastructure, employing automation, and infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.

-Build and maintain our code pipelines, designing and building automation in order to enable agile software development, using self-service where possible.

-Collaborate efficiently and effectively with other team members and Software Engineers to solve complex problems.

-Quickly absorb context and knowledge while ramping up.

Skills/Experience:

Minimum Requirements:

-4-6 years experience in SRE, DevOps, or similar role

-Experience with cloud provider platforms such as AWS or GCP

-Experience with relational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL)

-Familiarity with Kubernetes

- Experience with GitOps CI/CD tools (e.g., Harness, Argo, Flux, Jenkins)

- Familiarity with declarative infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi)

-Exposure to logging, monitoring, metrics collection, and observability tools (e.g., DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, CloudWatch)

- Collaboration with other engineers working primarily in PST

Desired Skills (Nice to Haves):

- Experience with software development and automation in languages beyond shell scripting (e.g., golang, python, elixir, java, etc.)

- Experience with platform development of tools for development, staging, and integration environments

- Experience with debugging performance or networking issues in applications running on Kubernetes

- Experience with audit compliance (e.g., SOX, SOC2, ISO27001, PCI DSS)

- Working knowledge of UNIX-based Operating Systems

-Computer Science or Engineering degree


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

In this role, you will participate in automating infrastructure provisioning, managing containerized applications, and maintaining CI/CD workflows to ensure smooth and scalable deployments. You will work closely with senior engineers to troubleshoot issues, implement best practices, and enhance system reliability and performance across multi-cloud platforms. This is an excellent opportunity to grow your skills in a fast-paced, collaborative DevOps environment.

This contract position is open to remote candidates outside the United States in North/South America and will report to the Sr. Manager of DevOps Engineering.

What you get to do every day:

-Participate in an on-call rotation on a regular basis and respond to incidents reliably and professionally.

-Maintain and evolve our AWS cloud infrastructure, employing automation, and infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.

-Build and maintain our code pipelines, designing and building automation in order to enable agile software development, using self-service where possible.

-Collaborate efficiently and effectively with other team members and Software Engineers to solve complex problems.

-Quickly absorb context and knowledge while ramping up.

Skills/Experience:

Minimum Requirements:

-4-6 years experience in SRE, DevOps, or similar role

-Experience with cloud provider platforms such as AWS or GCP

-Experience with relational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL)

-Familiarity with Kubernetes

- Experience with GitOps CI/CD tools (e.g., Harness, Argo, Flux, Jenkins)

- Familiarity with declarative infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi)

-Exposure to logging, monitoring, metrics collection, and observability tools (e.g., DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, CloudWatch)

- Collaboration with other engineers working primarily in PST

Desired Skills (Nice to Haves):

- Experience with software development and automation in languages beyond shell scripting (e.g., golang, python, elixir, java, etc.)

- Experience with platform development of tools for development, staging, and integration environments

- Experience with debugging performance or networking issues in applications running on Kubernetes

- Experience with audit compliance (e.g., SOX, SOC2, ISO27001, PCI DSS)

- Working knowledge of UNIX-based Operating Systems

-Computer Science or Engineering degree

title: AI Automation Engineer
description:
Buscamos um(a) profissional especializado(a) em automação inteligente com Inteligência Artificial, com atuação de ponta a ponta, da arquitetura à implementação em produção. Esse papel é estratégico na criação de soluções escaláveis, seguras e inovadoras, conectando engenharia de software, IA aplicada a processos de negócio, automação de fluxos e cloud computing.


O profissional atuará no desenvolvimento de agentes autônomos inteligentes, integrações complexas entre sistemas e orquestração de automações em ambientes multi-cloud, colaborando com squads multidisciplinares.


O modelo de contrato para esta oportunidade é CLT.


Somos inquietos, somos desbravadores e estamos em constante transformação.


Por isso, estamos na busca constante de crescimento do nosso time com profissionais inovadores, que desafiam os limites e estejam preparados para embarcar nessa cultura.


Seja qual for o seu gênero, orientação sexual, idade, raça, etnia, crença ou deficiência, todos são bem-vindos no nosso time.


Responsabilidades Principais


Projetar e implementar arquiteturas de automação com IA, integradas a ambientes multi-cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP).


Desenvolver, treinar e evoluir agentes autônomos e assistentes virtuais utilizando LLMs, LangChain, RAG, MCP Server e Google Agentspace.


Criar e gerenciar pipelines de dados para alimentar modelos de IA e fluxos automatizados.


Integrar bancos de dados relacionais, NoSQL e vetoriais.


Desenvolver APIs e microsserviços escaláveis utilizando Node.js, Python e PHP.


Aplicar engenharia de prompt e arquiteturas multi-agentes em ambientes produtivos.


Desenvolver interfaces front-end leves para monitoramento e controle das automações.


Orquestrar ambientes de Cloud e DevOps com Docker, Git e pipelines CI/CD.


Garantir governança, compliance e rastreabilidade no uso de IA (versionamento de prompts, documentação e observabilidade).


Atuar em squads multidisciplinares, colaborando com times de negócio, design e tecnologia.


Requisitos Técnicos (Obrigatórios)


Inglês avançado

Experiência sólida em automação inteligente com IA


Vivência com LLMs e frameworks de IA (LangChain, RAG, OpenAI, Google Vertex AI)


Experiência com ferramentas de automação: n8n, Power Automate, Make ou Zapier


Desenvolvimento back-end com Node.js e/ou Python


Conhecimento em APIs, microsserviços e integração de sistemas


Experiência com Cloud Computing (Azure, AWS ou GCP)


Stack Técnica Desejável

IA & LLMs


OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, LangChain, RAG, Banco de Dados Vetorial, MCP Server


Automação & Orquestração


n8n, Power Automate, Make, Zapier


Agentes Autônomos, Engenharia de Prompt


Back-End


Node.js, Python, PHP


Front-End


ReactJS, Bootstrap, JavaScript


Cloud & DevOps


Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud


Git (GitHub / Bitbucket), Docker, CI/CD


Banco de Dados


SQL Server, Cosmos DB, MongoDB, BigQuery, MySQL


Ferramentas Complementares


Postman, Grafana, Kibana, AI Search


Terraform (diferencial)


Diferenciais

Experiência em ambientes multi-cloud e híbridos.


Integrações com CRM, ERP e Martech (Salesforce, SAP BTP, RD Station, HubSpot).


Certificações em Cloud ou IA (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).


Conhecimento em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ).


Capacidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio em fluxos automatizados mensuráveis.


Modelo de Trabalho

Modelo híbrido (1x por semana presencial) no endereço: Vila Nova Conceição, São Paulo/SP


Perfil Comportamental

Visão sistêmica e pensamento arquitetural.


Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas.


Comunicação clara com áreas técnicas e de negócio.


Organização, autonomia e senso de responsabilidade.


Interesse contínuo por inovação e evolução em IA.

title: Pesquisador em experiência do usuário
description:
Quem Somos?

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós?

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Delphi Especialista (IA)
description:
Se você é uma pessoa que é gente boa, gosta de aprender e é apaixonada por resultados, você está no lugar certo! Como maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, queremos construir um ecossistema cada vez mais forte, com pessoas que gostem de inovar e acreditem na colaboração para fazer a diferença!


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER

Atuar como referência técnica do time, liderando o desenvolvimento e a evolução de soluções de

software, dados e integrações com IA, garantindo qualidade técnica, sustentabilidade arquitetural e entrega contínua de valor ao negócio. Conduzir decisões técnicas no dia a dia, apoiar o crescimento do time e assegurar que as soluções sejam escaláveis, observáveis e alinhadas à estratégia da área.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ

  • Liderar tecnicamente o time de desenvolvimento, apoiando decisões de design, arquitetura e implementação;
  • Atuar de forma hands on no desenvolvimento de soluções complexas, mantendo proximidade com o código e com os problemas reais do produto;
  • Traduzir requisitos funcionais e não funcionais em soluções técnicas viáveis, avaliando alternativas e escolhendo as soluções tecnológicas mais adequadas, considerando trade-offs de qualidade, prazo, custo, escalabilidade, segurança e impacto operacional;
  • Contribuir ativamente para a evolução da arquitetura de aplicações, dados e integrações, garantindo consistência, escalabilidade e manutenibilidade;
  • Garantir a adoção de boas práticas de engenharia de software, como testes automatizados, versionamento, revisão de código, documentação e integração contínua;
  • Apoiar a construção e evolução de pipelines de dados, integrações assíncronas e soluções que se conectem a modelos de IA quando aplicável;
  • Atuar como ponto de referência técnica para o time, promovendo mentoria, troca de conhecimento e evolução da maturidade técnica;
  • Participar de discussões técnicas com produto, dados e áreas parceiras, apoiando decisões táticas e operacionais;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria técnica e propor soluções que aumentem eficiência, confiabilidade e qualidade do produto;
  • Criar ou evoluir componentes reutilizáveis, padrões e frameworks/plataformas quando necessário para acelerar o desenvolvimento;
  • Apoiar a priorização técnica do backlog, sinalizando riscos, dependências e impactos arquiteturais;
  • Atuar na análise e resolução de incidentes, investigando causa raiz e propondo melhorias estruturais;
  • Contribuir para a evolução dos processos de engenharia, alinhados aos objetivos de curto e médio prazo da área;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências de mercado, arquitetura, dados e IA, disseminando conhecimento no time;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das metas do time, influenciando práticas, priorização de tarefas e promovendo evolução contínua da qualidade técnica;
  • Propor inovações aplicáveis ao roadmap do produto, realizando provas de conceito e estudos de caso que aumentem competitividade, eficiência e qualidade da solução;


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

● Sólida experiência em Desenvolvimento Delphi;

● Domínio no desenvolvimento de APIs (REST-HORSE) e API First;

● Fundamento em testes unitários – Conhecimento em Dunit;

● Unigui e Firemonkey – Nível avançado;

● Banco de Dados PostgreSQL, MongoDB ou equivalentes;

● Arquitetura de software moderna, cloud native, microsserviços e orientada a eventos;

● Design Patterns, Clean Code e princípios de engenharia de software;

● Segurança no desenvolvimento e práticas de DevSecOps;

● Linguagem de programação avançada (Java ou equivalente) e frameworks (Spring, Spring Boot e Spring Cloud);

● NoSQL, Elastic, MongoDB ou equivalentes;

● Mensageria, RabbitMQ, Pub Sub ou equivalentes;

● IA e LLMs: uso via API, prompts, RAG e integração de IA em aplicações;

● Noções de pipelines de dados, Airflow, Beam ou equivalentes.

Job Description: Oracle Procurement Consultant (LATAM – Remote)

Location: Remote (Candidate must be based in LATAM)

Type: Contract


Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Oracle Procurement Consultant based in LATAM for a fully remote role. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with Oracle Procurement modules and must be bilingual in Spanish and English .


Key Responsibilities

  • Implement, configure, and support Oracle Procurement modules
  • Gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into Oracle solutions

title: Talent Acquisition Manager - NAMER
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Manager to lead and scale recruitment operations for NAMER (North America) clients within an AI/R company structure. This role is responsible for building high-performing talent acquisition strategies to support growth in cutting-edge areas such as Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and advanced software engineering.

You will act as a strategic partner to clients and internal leadership, ensuring hiring excellence, speed, quality, and alignment with business goals in a highly competitive and innovation-driven market.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end talent acquisition strategies for NAMER clients, managing full-cycle recruitment across technical roles within AI/R and technology environments;
  • Partner closely with clients, hiring managers, and executives to understand workforce planning, role requirements, and hiring priorities;
  • Build, manage, and develop high-performing recruiting teams, ensuring delivery excellence, hiring quality, and adherence to SLAs;
  • Design and optimize recruiting processes tailored to the NAMER market, including sourcing strategies, interview frameworks, and candidate experience;
  • Drive hiring initiatives for highly specialized roles, including AI Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, Data Scientists, Cloud Engineers, and Product roles;
  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients, providing market insights, talent trends and compensation benchmarks;
  • Ensure compliance with NAMER labor regulations, diversity hiring practices, and internal recruitment standards;
  • Manage recruiting metrics and KPIs;
  • Support employer branding initiatives and represent the company in talent and industry events when applicable;
  • Collaborate with HR, People Operations, and leadership teams to align talent acquisition with broader organizational strategy.

Required Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Talent Acquisition Manager or Senior Talent Acquisition Partner in technology-driven environments;
  • Strong experience recruiting for the NAMER market, with a primary focus on US hiring practices;
  • Demonstrated success hiring for AI, Machine Learning, Data, Cloud, and software engineering roles;
  • Experience managing recruiting teams and working with multiple stakeholders and clients simultaneously;
  • Deep knowledge of full-cycle recruitment, sourcing strategies, and talent market dynamics in NAMER;
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills;
  • Experience working in fast-paced, scaling, or consulting environments.
  • Advanced English
  • Strong data-driven mindset

title: Executive Recruiter
description:
Executive Recruiter (Fluent English – C1/C2) | 100% Remote | U.S. Market


Blue Dot BPO connects strategic LATAM talent with mission-critical operations at U.S.-based companies. As we continue to expand, we are looking for an Executive Recruiter to lead high-impact executive hiring processes while working directly with senior leadership teams in the United States.


This is a fully remote role with a high level of autonomy, international exposure, and end-to-end ownership of executive recruiting processes.


What We Offer

  • Fixed pay of R$5,000 , plus additional bonuses in USD
  • Fully remote work (Monday to Friday, 1 PM to 10 PM BRT )
  • Long-term contract with real growth opportunities
  • Strategic exposure to U.S.-based executives and C-level teams
  • Multicultural, performance-driven environment focused on process, accountability, and meritocracy


Your Responsibilities

  • Lead full-cycle executive recruitment for senior and leadership roles
  • Develop advanced sourcing strategies and market mapping
  • Conduct structured interviews and in-depth candidate assessments
  • Manage strategic pipelines and stakeholder relationships
  • Coordinate interview processes with U.S.-based teams
  • Ensure operational excellence in ATS usage and recruitment data


What We’re Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience in executive recruiting / headhunting
  • Fluent English (C1/C2) for daily professional communication
  • Hunter mindset , analytical thinking, and strong results orientation
  • Proficiency with LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS platforms, and job boards
  • Strong communication skills, a consultative approach , and high organizational standards


Nice to Have

  • Prior experience in full-cycle executive recruiting
  • Familiarity with U.S. recruiting practices and market


Technical Requirements

  • Laptop with i7 processor (or equivalent) and 12GB+ RAM
  • Two monitors for daily operations
  • High-speed internet
  • Professional headset
  • Quiet and structured home office environment


Build Your International Career

If you want to work directly with the U.S. market, gain executive-level recruiting experience, and grow in a high-performance, process-driven environment, this opportunity is for you.


Apply now and become part of Blue Dot BPO.

title: Supply Chain Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.

- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.

- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.

- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.


Requirements:


- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.

- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.

- Experience in managing inventory.

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Tech Lead Python
description:
Tech Lead - Python


A Shipay simplifica a forma de as empresas receberem e pagarem por meios digitais, como Pix, Bolepix e Carteiras Digitais. Com a regulamentação da Duplicata Escritural, vamos viabilizar o Pagamento em Duas Etapas, além de um hub de escrituração de duplicatas. 


Buscamos um(a) Líder Técnico(a) para guiar nossa equipe no desenvolvimento de soluções de alta qualidade, escaláveis e eficientes. Importante: Este papel foca na excelência tecnológica e mentoria técnica, não sendo responsável pela gestão de pessoas .


Responsabilidades


  • Excelência Técnica: Projetar, implementar e testar serviços de back-end de forma iterativa, garantindo a qualidade e manutenibilidade do código.
  • Desenvolvimento Ativo: Atuar de forma \"hands-on\" no desenvolvimento de aplicações distribuídas e assíncronas, sendo a referência técnica para o time nas entregas das sprints.
  • Padrões e Práticas: Definir e implementar as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento, aplicando Design e Enterprise Patterns.
  • Gestão de Riscos: Realizar estimativas de projetos, identificar riscos técnicos e criar planos de mitigação para débitos técnicos.
  • Mentoria e Resolução: Atuar como mentor técnico para o desenvolvimento profissional dos membros da equipe e resolver problemas técnicos complexos.
  • Colaboração: Trabalhar em conjunto com a gestão para garantir a eficiência das entregas nos times.


Requisitos


  • Experiência em Python: Domínio em desenvolvimento utilizando Python, Flask, FastAPI e SqlAlchemy.
  • Arquitetura: Sólida experiência com Programação Orientada a Objetos, Modelagem de Dados e arquitetura de microsserviços em ambiente Cloud.
  • Qualidade de Software: Vivência no desenvolvimento e teste de aplicações distribuídas, assíncronas e aplicação de testes de software.
  • Visão de Engenharia: Experiência na aplicação de Design e Enterprise Patterns.
  • Habilidade Analítica: Capacidade de realizar estimativas precisas e gerir débitos técnicos de forma estratégica.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Habilidade para depuração e solução de problemas técnicos de alta complexidade.


Benefícios


  • Caju: Flexibilidade VR/VA em um só cartão.
  • Bônus: Até 2,5 salários por performance (individual e da empresa).
  • Saúde: Plano Porto Seguro.
  • Odonto: Plano Metlife.
  • Filhos: Auxílio-creche.
  • Segurança: Seguro de vida.
  • Desenvolvimento: Acesso Alura (plataforma de aprendizado).
  • Família: Licenças maternidade/paternidade estendidas (Empresa Cidadã).
  • Day-off: Folga para comemorar o seu aniversário.


Local de Trabalho


  • 100% Remoto .
  • Caso prefira, nosso escritório em São Paulo (próximo das estações Anhangabaú e São Bento) está disponível para uso.

title: Senior Growth Manager (Brazil)
description:
About us


We are a leading global player in the digital assets industry, operating one of the most advanced and trusted ecosystems in the blockchain space. With a user base exceeding 120 million worldwide, our platform offers a comprehensive suite of digital asset products and services designed to meet the needs of both retail and institutional clients.


Our mission is to accelerate the evolution of the digital economy by enabling secure, intelligent, and efficient transactions. We believe digital assets are redefining the foundations of global finance — and we are committed to empowering that transformation responsibly.


As one of the fastest-growing organizations in the sector, we foster a culture of innovation, integrity, and excellence. For professionals seeking meaningful challenges, cutting-edge projects, and the opportunity to shape the future of finance, we provide an environment that values both expertise and vision.


What you'll do


  • Drive overall business expansion across the Brazil region, setting strategies and delivering measurable growth.
  • Oversee business development, marketing, and operations with a deep understanding of growth levers to boost user acquisition and trading activity.
  • Operate as a true business owner—design new initiatives to elevate operational excellence, refine the local business model, and execute plans end-to-end.
  • Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing local team, determining hiring needs and shaping the long-term market strategy.
  • Manage budgeting, P&L performance, and financial goals to meet user and trading volume targets.
  • Lead major local marketing efforts, including partnership development and the execution of key events.
  • Serve as the company’s representative at local events, in media engagements, and in communications with external stakeholders.


What You’ll Need

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience with demonstrated success in a comparable leadership role.
  • Exceptional interpersonal abilities and proven leadership skills with an entrepreneurial mindset.
  • A strong passion for the cryptocurrency space.
  • Native-level proficiency in Portuguese and English.

title: Sr Data Engineer
description:
Sobre nós:

A Unlimitail é uma joint venture entre o Grupo Carrefour e o Grupo Publicis, que tem como objetivo atender ao crescente mercado de retail media na Europa e América Latina, desenvolvendo soluções eficazes para as principais necessidades do mercado: vender mais, personalização, oportunidades para as marcas, medição e transparência e presença omnicanal.

A empresa se destaca no mercado hoje graças à sua experiência e tecnologia de publicidade de ponta, CitrusAd powered by Epsilon, que unifica recursos onsite e offsite. Além disso, a Unlimitail oferece alcance global e dados de alta qualidade, com mais de 1,5 bilhão de visualizações de página mensais e um banco de dados de mais de 120 milhões de clientes endereçáveis em todo o mundo.



Contexto da Vaga de Emprego:

Você fará parte do Data Pipelines Squad, responsável por ingerir, preparar e normalizar fontes de dados que alimentam produtos de analytics, IA e retail media. O time atua com Arquitetura Medallion (Bronze > Silver), e a plataforma central de dados é construída sobre a Google Cloud, com forte foco em BigQuery e dbt para transformações e datasets governados.



Missão:

Como Senior Data Engineer, você será responsável por construir e operar pipelines confiáveis que movem dados de fontes brutas para camadas curadas e reutilizáveis. Garantirá a qualidade, consistência e performance dos conjuntos de dados utilizados pelos times de analytics e data science. Você será uma referência técnica sênior dentro do squad, influenciando arquitetura e padrões, além de trabalhar de forma próxima com stakeholders globais, utilizando inglês no dia a dia.



Principais Atividades:

Ingestão e Preparação de Dados

  • Consumir dados de múltiplas fontes (APIs, arquivos, bancos de dados, parceiros e sistemas internos);
  • Implementar padrões de ingestão na camada Bronze (dados brutos, auditáveis e reproduzíveis).

Transformações Medallion com dbt

  • Desenvolver e manter projetos em dbt para construção de datasets curados;
  • Desenhar e implementar transformações de Bronze para Silver (dados limpos, normalizados e conformados);
  • Definir modelos reutilizáveis, macros e documentação alinhados ao consumo analítico.

Engenharia e Otimização em BigQuery

  • Construir e otimizar datasets no BigQuery;
  • Melhorar performance, particionamento, clusterização e eficiência de custos;
  • Garantir design escalável para grandes volumes de dados e ciclos frequentes de atualização.

Qualidade e Governança de Dados

  • Implementar checagens de qualidade de dados (atualização, completude, variação de schema, anomalias);
  • Garantir rastreabilidade, versionamento e clareza de ownership dos principais datasets;
  • Manter documentação e padrões para ativos de dados compartilhados.

Colaboração e Enablement

  • Atuar em parceria com times de Analytics/BI (consumidores de Looker e Looker Studio) e Data Science;
  • Alinhar com stakeholders de Produto e Negócio, traduzindo necessidades em contratos de dados;
  • Trabalhar diariamente com um squad global (Brasil + França), em inglês.



Habilidades Necessárias:

  • Forte experiência como Senior Data Engineer;
  • SQL avançado;
  • Experiência prática sólida com dbt (requisito central);
  • Forte experiência com BigQuery (modelagem, otimização e controle de custos);
  • Experiência no desenho de pipelines ELT confiáveis e camadas de dados curadas;
  • Boas práticas de engenharia de software (Git, code review, documentação);
  • Excelente comunicação e gestão de stakeholders;
  • Inglês avançado (obrigatório).



Habilidades Desejadas:

  • Experiência com Terraform ou Infrastructure as Code (quando aplicável);
  • Experiência em varejo, e-commerce, marketplace ou retail media;
  • CI/CD para workflows de dados;
  • Vivência com padrões orientados a eventos ou near real-time;
  • Francês será um diferencial.



Perfil Preferencial:

  • Contribuidor individual sênior;
  • Data engineer com mentalidade de plataforma;
  • Forte experiência prática com dbt e BigQuery;
  • Confortável em construir e manter camadas Bronze e Silver em uma Arquitetura Medallion;
  • Foco em confiabilidade, qualidade e escalabilidade dos dados;
  • Confortável em atuar nos bastidores, habilitando squads de analytics e IA;
  • Forte senso de ownership sobre os principais ativos de dados;
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma autônoma em ambientes globais e complexos;
  • Comunicação clara, colaborando com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos;
  • Influencia arquitetura e padrões por excelência técnica, não por hierarquia.

title: Senior Visual Designer
description:
What is Teachable?

Teachable is the platform for experts and businesses who take education seriously. In a world where anyone can ask AI for information, we're the home for those who educate with purpose, modernity, and humanity. We help experts and businesses scale their impact and operations through courses, coaching, and digital downloads that students actually love. From a finance expert teaching Python for investment analysis to a multilingual coach offering business Spanish for executives, Teachable powers human-led learning that drives student trust, connection, and results. With a sleek, intuitive interface and AI as a time-saving partner, the platform enables transformative education rooted in real-world experience. Teachable experts have lived it—that's why they teach it.Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey?

Part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators, experts, and businesses earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to cement itself as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize student outcomes, business growth, and flexibility. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of real-world learning to shape the future, we want you on our team!


About your team


Our Brand & Content team is a group of social media experts, newsletter writers, designers, copywriters, and event pros—all working together to build a world-class brand creators love. We focus on growing Teachable’s reach, connecting with new and existing audiences, and using content, design, and in-person experiences to drive awareness, generate leads, and deepen engagement.


What is the role?


We’re looking for a highly creative, results-oriented Brand Designer to join our Brand + Content Team. This role is for a strategic thinker with strong design execution skills and a deep understanding of brand systems. You’ll help shape and scale our visual storytelling, building cohesive brand expressions that drive engagement and recognition across campaigns, events, and experiences.

This role focuses on evolving and extending visual identity systems and applying brand guidelines across digital and physical touchpoints. You’ll design multi-channel marketing assets spanning email, paid media, social, web, and print, with an eye for consistency and craft. The ideal candidate also brings strengths in web and motion design to support a multidisciplinary team.

While an individual contributor role, you’ll collaborate closely with other designers—offering thoughtful critique, feedback, and informal mentorship—and partner cross-functionally to create design that resonates with our audience and reinforces our brand story.


In this role, you will:


  • Build upon and evolve brand guidelines by establishing sophisticated visual systems that align with business goals.
  • Proactively propose solutions to help improve project outcomes across a range of project types, including marketing and product.
  • Conceptualize and execute high-impact design across diverse formats: digital & print, event identities, promotional assets, and marketing materials that extend the Teachable brand.
  • Demonstrate versatility in applying design thinking to varied channels while maintaining cohesion across all output.
  • Foster a collaborative environment and work closely with stakeholders and cross-functional stakeholders including web, product marketing, growth, and events—to ensure creative execution aligns with GTM strategy, brand objectives, and campaign goals.
  • Provide mentorship to junior designers on the team.
  • Present creative concepts to teams across the organization in a clear and compelling manner.
  • Strive to maintain the brand standard across all projects and ensure consistency.
  • Manage end-to-end production for creative deliverables, including preparing files for presentations, cross functional partners, print vendors, and event production.
  • Build trusted relationships with cross-functional peers through clear communication, curiosity, and accountability.
  • Contribute motion design and animation to campaigns, launches, or brand moments that deepen storytelling and audience engagement.
  • Stay up to date on design trends and tools, with a particular focus on leveraging AI in design workflows


What you’ll bring:


  • Experience: 5+ years of visual design experience, with a strong focus on branding and performance marketing
  • Experience working collaboratively alongside fellow designers and/or offering mentorship/coaching to other designers
  • Skills: Excels in the Adobe Creative Suite and Figma
  • Portfolio: A strong portfolio showcasing a diverse range of design projects and assets (including email, social, paid advertising, print, etc.) , plus motion design
  • Strong design sensibility with attention to detail, typography, and visual storytelling.
  • Ability to adapt to brand guidelines while pushing creative boundaries; experience refining and scaling brand guidelines.
  • Strong collaboration skills and ability to work cross-functionally with marketers, designers, and content creators.
  • Self-starter with excellent organizational and time-management skills.
  • Understanding: Demonstrated understanding of brand identities, digital marketing principles, website design best practices, and performance marketing metrics.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and presentation skills to effectively communicate design concepts to stakeholders and gather feedback.
  • Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and adapt to changing priorities.


Nice to have:

  • Experience working in SaaS, edtech, or within the creator economy.
  • Familiarity with video editing tools (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or similar).
  • Knowledge of current trends in motion design, animation, and paid and social media.


While Teachable maintains our NY office for local employees to use, we operate as a remote-first culture in order to give our employees added flexibility. In order to maintain connection and create a community beyond the screen, Teachable holds in-person events throughout the year, where employees and teams can come together for bonding, strategic alignment, goal-setting, and celebrations!

title: Junior .NET Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We seek a proficient Junior .NET Developer capable of maintaining high standards of technical quality and innovation, dedicated to continuous improvement, and committed to assisting clients worldwide. Success in this role requires detailed knowledge of development techniques, excellent communication, and organizational skills.


Key responsibilities:


- Architect and develop various services and APIs

- Apply SOLID principles to craft maintainable and high-quality code

- Collaborate with product owners to ensure features/changes align with business requirements and degreed strategy

- Engage closely with designers, UX, and other developers to grasp new features, dependencies, and technical intricacies

- Fulfill other assigned duties


Requirements:


- Advanced proficiency in English (spoken and written)

- Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL Databases

- Experience with Microservices and the Cloud

- Knowledge of algorithms

- Understanding of IT infrastructure

- Proficiency in managing Agile methodologies

- Familiarity with best practices, SOLID principles, CLEAN Code, and scalable solutions

- Understanding of Design Patterns

- Experience in developing entire applications from scratch

- Proficiency in automated tests, CI/CD pipelines

- Experience with version control

- Strong skills in unit testing, integration testing, and code coverage


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Analista financeiro
description:
Descrição da Empresa Somos uma concessionaria de caminhões .

Descrição do Cargo Estamos em busca de um Analista Financeiro para integrar nossa equipe em Curitiba, PR. Este cargo implica em participar ativamente de atividades cotidianas relacionadas ao contas a receber, e à elaboração de relatórios. Entre as responsabilidades estão a análise de demonstrações financeiras, o suporte em estratégias de planejamento financeiro e o acompanhamento dos resultados da empresa para garantir a eficiência e sustentabilidade das operações. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e requer a presença no local.

Qualificações

  • Planejamento Financeiro: Experiência em planejamento financeiro para apoiar decisões estratégicas e operacionais dentro da empresa.
  • Habilidades Analíticas: Capacidade de analisar dados financeiros detalhadamente para identificar tendências e apoiar análises críticas.
  • Conhecimento em Finanças: Domínio de práticas e princípios financeiros em geral que suportem o desempenho econômico da empresa.
  • Formação em administração, economia, contabilidade ou áreas relacionadas. Conhecimento em ferramentas de análise financeira e fluência em inglês serão considerados diferenciais.

title: Desenvolvedor Java Pleno
description:
Responsabilidades:

  • Atuar como referência técnica no desenvolvimento e sustentação de soluções para o setor de telecomunicações.
  • Colaborar na definição da arquitetura e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Participar ativamente da sustentação das integrações existentes e evolução de novos produtos.
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores plenos e juniores.
  • Apoiar processos de pré-vendas e apresentações técnicas para clientes.

Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento Java (preferência para Java 11+).
  • Proficiência com Spring Boot e ecossistema Spring (Web, Security, Data).
  • Experiência com integrações via APIs REST, mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ) e microserviços.
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle, PostgreSQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis).
  • Vivência com Docker, Kubernetes e ambientes cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure).
  • Familiaridade com API Gateways como Kong ou Apigee.
  • Experiência com observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger ou ELK).

Competências Comportamentais:

  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e colaborar com diferentes áreas técnicas.
  • Habilidade para gerenciar projetos e atuar em um ambiente de alta complexidade.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação para clientes.
  • Proatividade para identificar e resolver problemas técnicos.
  • Visão sistêmica sobre o desenvolvimento de soluções escaláveis e resilientes.

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em Golang.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento front-end (React, Vue ou Angular).
  • Conhecimento de segurança de APIs e práticas de CQRs.
  • Experiência com PL/SQL e tuning de queries.

Você vai amar trabalhar aqui se:

  • Quiser ter a possibilidade de aprender e trabalhar com diversas tecnologias;
  • Estiver em busca de uma empresa com possibilidades reais de crescimento e carreira;
  • Estiver em busca de um ambiente leve e descontraído para trabalhar;

Nossos benefícios:

description:

Especialidade em Backend.

- Lógica de Programação;

- Arquitetura de Software (cloudnative, web, microserviços);

- APIs REST;

- Banco de Dados SQL Relacionais (PostgreSQL, equivalentes);

- Testes Automatizados (JUnit, Jest, Karma ou equivalentes);

- DevOps (CI/CD, Docker, Git/GitFlow, GitLab, Jenkins ou similar);

- Feature Flags e estratégias de deploy;

- Sistemas Distribuídos, Escalabilidade, Resiliência (nível intermediário);

- NoSQL (Elastic, MongoDB ou equivalente);

- Cache (Redis);

- Infraestrutura como código (Terraform)(opcional)

- Orquestração de containers (Kubernetes)(opcional)

- Cloud Storage (Google Cloud Storage ou equivalente)

- Processamento distribuído (Hadoop, Spark)

- Pipelines de dados/streaming (Apache Beam, Dataflow, Airflow)

- Processamento assíncrono (Celery, Temporal IO)

- MCP (opcional)

- Copilot ou equivalente (opcional)

- Provedores de Cloud (GCP, AWS, Azure, equivalentes)

- Design Patterns

- Segurança no desenvolvimento (DevSecOps, outros)

- APIFirts e boas práticas de desenvolvimento (CleanCode, etc...)

- Observabilidade e troubleshooting de aplicações em produção (logs estruturados, métricas, traces)

- Metodologia Ágil

- Java avançado

- Spring / Spring Boot / Spring Cloud

- Hibernate ou equivalente ORM

- Experiência em integrações complexas (REST APIs externas)

Certificações: Relacionadas a área como por exemplo Java, Spring, Python, Front-end ou Cloud Provider.

title: Javascript/React Software Developer - Contractor
description:
Position: Javascript/React Software Developer – Contractor

Location: Remote – Brazil

Contract Type: Service Contract (PJ/Freelancer)

Role Overview:

We are seeking a Software Developer with strong expertise in Javascript and React and proven web programming experience. The ideal candidate is also comfortable working with other programming languages, has advanced coding skills, and in-depth knowledge of modern HTML/CSS.

Responsibilities:

  • Write well-structured, testable, and efficient code following best development practices.
  • Create website layouts and user interfaces using modern HTML/CSS standards.
  • Integrate data from multiple back-end services and databases.
  • Develop back-end services using Node.js.
  • Work with other programming languages as required.
  • Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends, applying them to projects.
  • Collaborate with designers to ensure visual design alignment.
  • Preferred: experience with mobile development (iOS/Android) or React Native.

Requirements & Skills:

  • Solid experience in Javascript, React, and Node.js.
  • Strong programming skills and in-depth knowledge of modern HTML/CSS.
  • Understanding of web application functionality, including security and best practices.
  • Proven track record in web programming.
  • Knowledge of relational databases, object-oriented programming, and web application development.
  • Problem-solving and creative diagnosis skills.
  • Strong organizational skills to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new technologies.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
  • Fluent English (written and spoken).

Nice-to-Haves / Differentials:

  • Experience with Web3, MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js).
  • Mobile app development and integration with hardware SDKs, drones, or sensors.
  • Experience with prototyping, algorithms, R&D, QA, and software quality assurance.

Contract Details:

title: Lead Data Architect – Azure Databricks & Advanced
description:
Lead Data Architect – Azure Databricks & Advanced Analytics


Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Lead Data Architect with deep expertise in Azure Databricks and advanced analytics to design and deliver scalable, cloud-native data solutions. This role requires strong hands-on technical skills combined with architectural leadership to drive end-to-end analytics platforms aligned with business objectives.

The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience in big data technologies, data engineering, and Azure cloud services, with a strong focus on Databricks, SQL, and modern data lakehouse architectures.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of advanced analytics solutions using Azure Databricks and Microsoft Fabric
  • Collaborate closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional IT teams to gather requirements and translate them into effective data solutions
  • Own end-to-end delivery of data platforms, ensuring alignment with business needs, architectural standards, and best practices
  • Design and develop scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes using Azure Databricks, PySpark, and related tools
  • Integrate Azure Databricks with other Azure services, including Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory , and on-premise systems
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to data engineering teams, fostering continuous learning and innovation
  • Ensure comprehensive documentation of data architectures, pipelines, and data flows
  • Enforce best practices for code quality, data security, governance, and scalability
  • Stay current with evolving Databricks and Azure technologies to drive continuous improvement and innovation


Essential Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with Azure Databricks , including cluster management, notebook development, and Delta Lake
  • Proficiency in big data technologies such as Spark, Hadoop , and data processing frameworks like PySpark
  • Deep understanding of Azure services including Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS Gen2), Azure Synapse, and Azure Data Factory
  • Experience designing and implementing ETL/ELT pipelines, data lakes, and data warehouses
  • Advanced SQL skills and familiarity with NoSQL databases
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and version control systems such as Git
  • Strong knowledge of cloud security and governance best practices


Soft Skills

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Strong problem-solving mindset with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues
  • Proven leadership and mentoring skills, with experience leading and guiding data engineering teams


Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with Power BI for dashboarding and reporting
  • Exposure to Microsoft Fabric for analytics and integration workloads
  • Knowledge of Spark Streaming for real-time data processing
  • Familiarity with Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices


Experience Requirements

  • 12+ years of demonstrated experience in developing data ingestion and transformation pipelines using Databricks, Azure Synapse notebooks, and Azure Data Factory
  • Strong hands-on experience with Delta Tables, Delta Lake, and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2
  • Proven expertise using Auto Loader and Delta Live Tables for efficient data ingestion and transformation
  • Experience building and optimizing query layers using Databricks SQL
  • Demonstrated experience integrating Databricks with Azure Synapse, ADLS Gen2, and Power BI for end-to-end analytics solutions
  • Prior experience developing, optimizing, and deploying Power BI reports
  • Solid understanding of modern CI/CD practices , particularly for Databricks and cloud-native architectures

  • Enforce best practices for code quality, data security, governance, and scalability
  • Stay current with evolving Databricks and Azure technologies to drive continuous improvement and innovation

  • Strong hands-on experience with Azure Databricks , including cluster management, notebook development, and Delta Lake
  • Proficiency in big data technologies such as Spark, Hadoop , and data processing frameworks like PySpark
  • Deep understanding of Azure services including Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS Gen2), Azure Synapse, and Azure Data Factory
  • Experience designing and implementing ETL/ELT pipelines, data lakes, and data warehouses
  • Advanced SQL skills and familiarity with NoSQL databases
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and version control systems such as Git
  • Strong knowledge of cloud security and governance best practices


Soft Skills

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Strong problem-solving mindset with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues
  • Proven leadership and mentoring skills, with experience leading and guiding data engineering teams


Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with Power BI for dashboarding and reporting
  • Exposure to Microsoft Fabric for analytics and integration workloads
  • Knowledge of Spark Streaming for real-time data processing
  • Familiarity with Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices


Experience Requirements

  • 12+ years of demonstrated experience in developing data ingestion and transformation pipelines using Databricks, Azure Synapse notebooks, and Azure Data Factory
  • Strong hands-on experience with Delta Tables, Delta Lake, and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2
  • Proven expertise using Auto Loader and Delta Live Tables for efficient data ingestion and transformation
  • Experience building and optimizing query layers using Databricks SQL
  • Demonstrated experience integrating Databricks with Azure Synapse, ADLS Gen2, and Power BI for end-to-end analytics solutions
  • Prior experience developing, optimizing, and deploying Power BI reports
  • Solid understanding of modern CI/CD practices , particularly for Databricks and cloud-native architectures

title: Consultor de Vendas
description:
NOSSO MAIOR CRÉDITO É A CONFIANÇA DAS PESSOAS.

Somos um grande time conectado pelos mesmos valores, e para cumprirmos essa missão, acreditamos que a confiança é fundamental nessa jornada.

Queremos sempre estar junto, somando forças e experiências para oferecer o melhor atendimento aos clientes.

Aqui na help incentivamos a participação de variados públicos em nossos processos seletivos, promovendo a candidatura de pessoas negras, mulheres, LGBTQIAP+, acima dos 50 anos e PCDs. Desse modo, não enviesamos perguntas de cunho pessoal, favorecendo e tornando nosso ambiente mais inclusivo, diverso e respeitoso, buscando aumentar a pluralidade dos times.

E nossas vagas são para todos que sintam essa vontade inquietante de pertencer e compor um time único, confiante e forte que tem orgulho de dizer: #somoshelpers!

O que te espera no dia a dia?

  • Realizar prospecção de clientes ;
  • Realizar venda do produto Crédito Pessoal;
  • Cadastrar as propostas no sistema e fechamento de contratos;
  • Atuar na retenção e fidelização de clientes.

Esperamos que você tenha:

  • Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Perfil do Consultor de Vendas: Proativo, dinâmico, comunicativo, habilidade em negociação, organizado, foco no cliente e metas de vendas;
  • Desejável experiência com vendas e metas;
  • Conhecimento no Pacote Office.

Informações adicionais

Local de trabalho: Centro, Piedade (SP)

Jornada: 100% presencial

Horário de trabalho:

  • Segunda a quinta das 08h às 18h
  • Sexta feira das 08h às 17h

Remuneração:

Salário Fixo

Remuneração Variável

Benefícios, saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de saúde Unimed;
  • Plano odontológico MetLife;
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Alimentação;
  • Programa de Incentivo Educacional: Pagamos 100% da sua graduação, pós graduação, curso de idiomas ou cursos rápidos;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Acesse a Wellhub (antiga gympass) , uma plataforma que oferece uma rede de parceiros para atividades físicas e de saúde, ajudando você a manter um estilo de vida ativo e saudável.
  • Paceria com a plataforma da Psicologia Viva , em que você e seus dependentes conseguem fazer sessões de terapia 100% online e gratuito;
  • PAP - Programa de assessoria financeira, jurídica e psicológica.

E por fim, e mais importante, acreditamos no protagonismo dos nossos colaboradores, afinal, não é apenas sobre métodos, agilidade e digitalização. É sobre pessoas e o potencial que elas têm!

title: Senior Software Engineer (Node.js/JavaScript) — E-commerce
description:
About firmly

firmly solutions turn moments of product discovery (AI, social, content, ads, messaging, etc.) into instant purchases through its agentic commerce platform — with fast, embedded checkout and a strong focus on security and reliability.

If you enjoy building high-performance APIs, working on distributed systems, and shipping cloud-native solutions with real-world scale and constraints, you’ll fit right in.

What you’ll do

  • Build and evolve backend services and APIs in Node.js/JavaScript for critical e-commerce/checkout flows.
  • Develop edge/serverless systems on Cloudflare Workers (e.g., Workers and related services) focused on low latency, resilience, and scalability.
  • Design and implement partner integrations (APIs, webhooks, event-driven flows) and near real-time data sync (e.g., pricing, inventory, order status).
  • Improve observability (logs/metrics/tracing), incident readiness, and operational excellence (“you build it, you run it”).
  • Strengthen engineering quality through testing, code reviews, CI/CD improvements, and pragmatic architecture decisions.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally (Product, Partnerships, Data) and contribute as a technical leader/mentor within the team.

Required skills & experience

  • 6+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering.
  • Strong experience as a Senior Software Engineer building production-grade backends with Node.js/JavaScript.
  • Solid experience designing and operating APIs (REST and/or event-driven systems) with a quality mindset.
  • Hands-on experience with Cloudflare Workers (Workers and other services) OR strong serverless/edge background and willingness to go deep on Cloudflare.
  • Good foundation in data modeling and databases (SQL and/or NoSQL) for transactional systems.
  • Strong understanding of security fundamentals (authN/authZ, secrets management, least privilege, secure-by-default design).
  • Advanced English (spoken and written) — you’ll collaborate with a global team and participate in meetings/doc reviews in English.

Nice to have

  • Experience with payments, checkout, fraud/risk, or other mission-critical e-commerce systems.
  • Event-driven architectures, async processing, queues/streams.
  • Performance/latency optimization, caching, edge patterns.
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and Cloudflare Workers tooling (Wrangler); plus modern DevOps practices.

Benefits & Career Growth

  • Unimed Nacional health plan (coverage for spouse/partner and children).
  • Meal and food allowance (VR/VA).
  • Life insurance.
  • UniOdonto dental plan.
  • Career growth & advancement opportunities (mentorship, ownership, and room to grow with the team).
  • Clear growth path (regular feedback and performance cycles).
  • Ownership & autonomy (high-impact work, end-to-end responsibility).
  • Learning & development support.

How to apply

Click Easy Apply on LinkedIn and attach your resume (PDF).

  • Tip: parts of the interview process may be conducted in English.

  • Develop edge/serverless systems on Cloudflare Workers (e.g., Workers and related services) focused on low latency, resilience, and scalability.
  • Design and implement partner integrations (APIs, webhooks, event-driven flows) and near real-time data sync (e.g., pricing, inventory, order status).
  • Improve observability (logs/metrics/tracing), incident readiness, and operational excellence (“you build it, you run it”).
  • Strengthen engineering quality through testing, code reviews, CI/CD improvements, and pragmatic architecture decisions.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally (Product, Partnerships, Data) and contribute as a technical leader/mentor within the team.

Required skills & experience

  • 6+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering.
  • Strong experience as a Senior Software Engineer building production-grade backends with Node.js/JavaScript.
  • Solid experience designing and operating APIs (REST and/or event-driven systems) with a quality mindset.
  • Hands-on experience with Cloudflare Workers (Workers and other services) OR strong serverless/edge background and willingness to go deep on Cloudflare.
  • Good foundation in data modeling and databases (SQL and/or NoSQL) for transactional systems.
  • Strong understanding of security fundamentals (authN/authZ, secrets management, least privilege, secure-by-default design).
  • Advanced English (spoken and written) — you’ll collaborate with a global team and participate in meetings/doc reviews in English.

Nice to have

  • Experience with payments, checkout, fraud/risk, or other mission-critical e-commerce systems.
  • Event-driven architectures, async processing, queues/streams.
  • Performance/latency optimization, caching, edge patterns.
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and Cloudflare Workers tooling (Wrangler); plus modern DevOps practices.

Benefits & Career Growth

  • Unimed Nacional health plan (coverage for spouse/partner and children).

  • UniOdonto dental plan.
  • Career growth & advancement opportunities (mentorship, ownership, and room to grow with the team).
  • Clear growth path (regular feedback and performance cycles).
  • Ownership & autonomy (high-impact work, end-to-end responsibility).
  • Learning & development support.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for \"Full Stack Developer\" ,Remote mode in Sao Paulo who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Mandatory skills:

  • 6+ years of experience with Java;
  • Experience with front-end (Angular);
  • Experience with AWS;
  • Advanced English


Requirements:

  • Experience in the financial industry (preferably banks);
  • Microservices;
  • Websphere;
  • OraaS;
  • MQ Series;
  • ORACLE;
  • PL/SQL;
  • KAFKA,
  • MONGODB;
  • DevOps tools as a developer





What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Desenvolvedor React & JavaScript Vanilla Pleno
description:
Sua próxima oportunidade está a caminho!


A VILT é uma empresa de TI, onde valorizamos nosso pessoal, promovemos o trabalho em equipe e, é claro, o bom humor.


Acreditamos que a diversidade e a inclusão fortalecem o nosso time. Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas, e profissionais com deficiência (PCDs) são incentivados a se candidatar.

Dê uma olhada nesta oportunidade de emprego e veja se você é o próximo VILTian! (se você conhece alguém, não se esqueça de recomendá-lo)


Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Frontend Pleno com foco em React e JavaScript Vanilla para atuar na construção e evolução de aplicações web escaláveis e de alto impacto. O conhecimento em Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) é um diferencial , mas caso ainda não tenha tido contato, é importante ter interesse em aprender e evoluir nessa stack.


O que você irá fazer:

  • Desenvolver e evoluir interfaces web com React e JavaScript Vanilla
  • Criar interações diretas manipulando o DOM quando necessário
  • Integrar aplicações com APIs REST
  • Construir componentes reutilizáveis com foco em performance
  • Participar de decisões técnicas e discussões de solução
  • Atuar em code reviews e apoiar na qualidade do código do time
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares, com comunicação clara


O que esperamos de você:

  • Mínimo 3 anos de experiência com React e JavaScript
  • Domínio de React: hooks, estado, componentização e performance
  • Forte base em JavaScript Vanilla: DOM, eventos e consumo de APIs sem frameworks
  • Experiência com Git
  • Boa comunicação e perfil colaborativo
  • Autonomia, foco e organização
  • Conhecimento em HTML semântico e CSS moderno
  • Interesse em aprender e trabalhar com AEM, caso ainda não tenha experiência


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia com AEM (Adobe Experience Manager)


Informações adicionais:

  • Modelo de contrato CLT.


Se você estiver pronto para levar sua carreira de desenvolvimento web para o próximo nível, adoraríamos conhecê-lo!
