title: Consultor de vendas
description:
Vaga (trabalho remoto):

  • Consultor(a) Comercial B2C em Escola Online de Alemão e Inglês


Salário:

  • R$1.977,75 + comissões


Regime:

  • CLT (dedicação exclusiva) | Home Office


Jornada:

  • Segunda a Sexta-feira: 12h30 às 21h30 | Intervalo: 17h-18h
  • Sábados: 09h às 13h


Benefícios:

  • Auxílio-alimentação de R$533,95;
  • Auxílio-saúde de R$138,33 para usar com academia, farmácia ou outros gastos ;
  • Auxílio home-office de R$181,54 para pacote de internet, dentre outros;
  • Vale-inglês: curso de inglês completo + exclusivo instrutor de idioma por IA;
  • Vale-alemão: curso de alemão + exclusivo instrutor de idioma por IA;
  • Clude Saúde: consultas médicas + nutricionista + desconto em farmácias;
  • C4Life: terapia online, diagnóstico e análise de comportamento, coaching, consultorias jurídicas, e mais;
  • Totalpass: 20 mil academias e estúdios, totalplay, totalclub, queima diária, terapia, nutrição;
  • Grupo de motivação fitness;
  • Bradesco Odonto: opção por contribuição, aberto a dependentes, com urgência, 2 limpezas por ano e exames + clube de vantagens;
  • Banco de horas flexível;
  • Treinamentos em vendas, marketing e gestão;
  • Kit de boas vindas;
  • #EUVISTOACAMISA: novas camisetas da escola a cada novo ano de empresa;
  • Day-off no aniversário + presente surpresa;
  • Convênio com o SESC: clubes, hospedagem, cursos, eventos e serviços para família;
  • Bônus anual de + 1 salário bruto se a empresa atingir meta anual;
  • Bônus Indique e Ganhe.


Palavras do gestor:

  • \"Procuramos um(a) consultor(a) comercial que saiba ouvir o cliente, consiga transmitir as informações de forma clara e persuasiva e que seja bom(a) em seguir processos e utilizar ferramentas de gestão\" R.F.


Principais atividades:

  • Realizar vendas B2C;
  • Conduzir reuniões através de videochamadas;
  • Realizar a qualificação, negociação, follow-up e fechamento de vendas.
  • Manter o CRM atualizado e organizado, seguindo os processos da empresa.
  • Participar ativamente de treinamentos, dailys e reuniões de alinhamento com a liderança.
  • Realizar ligações e atividades de prospecção.
  • Comprometimento com metas estabelecidas.


Requisitos:

  • Excelente comunicação oral e escrita.
  • Excelente digitação.
  • Organização, responsabilidade com processos e gestão do tempo.
  • Foco em resultados e performance comercial.
  • Facilidade para conduzir conversas consultivas, lidando bem com objeções e negociações.
  • Disciplina e responsabilidade para atuar em ambiente remoto (Home Office).
  • Abertura para receber feedbacks e buscar desenvolvimento contínuo.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia com ferramentas de CRM;
  • Conhecimento nas ferramentas: Discord, Notion e Google Meet;
  • Conhecimento em Inglês/Alemão;


Ambiente Home Office:

  • Dispor de ambiente tranquilo, computador com processamento ágil, webcam, mouse, teclado, internet estável, aparelho celular, mesa e cadeira adequadas.


Sobre a empresa:

  • A Sprache&Wissen (S&W) é uma edtech brasileira, fundada por dois irmãos mineiros: um administrador formado pelo CEFET-MG e uma professora doutora pela UFMG. O grupo educacional administra as marcas Clube de Alemão, Punkify e Vale-inglês. A S&W é a maior escola online de alemão da América Latina. No inglês, destaca-se com metodologia inovadora de aprendizagem acelerada e índice de 98,9% de satisfação. A empresa irá capacitar 100 mil brasileiros até 2030 nos idiomas alemão e inglês, possui mais de 500 mil seguidores nas redes sociais e tem valor de mercado superior a 30 milhões de reais.


Etapas do processo:

  • Seleção de currículos;
  • Vídeo de 1 minuto;
  • Entrevista 1;
  • Entrevista 2;
  • Ficha de candidatura;
  • Aprovação.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


We are looking for an experienced L2 Support Analyst to provide functional production support for enterprise Contract Management Software (CMS/CLM) platforms. This role focuses on incident resolution, configuration support, and close collaboration with business users and technical teams to ensure system stability and efficient contract operations.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide Level 2 production support for Contract Management Software platforms, including incident, problem, and service request management.
  • Analyze and resolve issues related to:
  • Contract templates, clause libraries, and fallback logic
  • Workflows, approvals, and business rule configurations
  • Metadata, attributes, and contract type setups
  • Perform root cause analysis for recurring functional and configuration-related issues.
  • Support minor enhancements and functional configuration changes (non-code).
  • Troubleshoot integration-related issues and coordinate with Level 3 technical teams when required.
  • Manage user access, role assignments, and permission-related issues.
  • Execute approved data corrections, metadata updates, and configuration fixes.
  • Support UAT and regression testing for fixes and minor platform updates.
  • Maintain support documentation, knowledge articles, and operational runbooks.
  • Collaborate closely with L1 support teams, business stakeholders, and L3 technical teams to ensure timely issue resolution.


Required Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years of experience providing production support for Contract Management Software (CLM/CMS) platforms (e.g., Icertis, Coupa CLM, DocuSign CLM, SAP CLM, or similar).
  • Strong hands-on experience with functional configurations, including:
  • Contract templates and clause libraries
  • Workflows, rules, and approvals
  • English (B2- Fluent)
  • Metadata, attributes, and contract types
  • Solid understanding of contract lifecycle management processes .
  • Experience working with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting enterprise SaaS applications in complex or regulated environments.
  • Exposure to system integrations with ERP, CRM, or document management platforms.
  • Familiarity with ITIL-based support models or Agile delivery environments.


UST is waiting for you!

title: App Modernization Architect
description:
13+ Years of development and app modernization experience. Experience in hosting and configuring the applications on IIS. Experience in modernization of Applications to Azure PaaS platform along with migration experience. Expertise in application hosting, configuration, optimization in various Azure PaaS services: Azure App service, Azure Functions, Aure Kubernetes Service, Azure Container Instance. Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to find alternate ways to reach the goals. Ability to understand application architecture, dependencies, and integrations . Should have led and managed the team with the size more than 5 members. Should be able to guide the team technically. Very good understanding of application migration scenarios and pathways.



  • Primary skills:
  • Hands on web application development skills
  • Hands on experience in developing and hosting web applications on Azure PaaS platform
  • Primary database skills like database connectivity, configurations etc.
  • Ability to analyze application dependencies.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise Architect, Data Platform, DevOps, and Integration Teams to ensure cloud adoption follows standard best practices.
  • Well versed with containerizing web application frontend and web services.
  • Should know the nitty-gritties of hosting containerized application on Kubernetes
  • Application performance assessment pre and post migration
  • Ensure that the proposed solution covers Azure strategy, stakeholder management as well as the actual solution covering business, application and Infrastructure as well as commercial aspects (in terms of value for money and not commercial costing etc.)
  • Understanding customer Infra landscape. Design Azure Landing Zone and provide the Azure target state solution architecture.




  • Secondary Skills:
  • Work with Internal stakeholders, Customer stakeholders and Project Managers to understand the migration requirements and provide solutions accordingly
  • Troubleshooting experience with Azure PaaS platform
  • Basic understanding of containerization and AKS service




  • Soft Skills:
  • Good customers connect
  • Positive attitude and excellent communication skills to manage customer calls
  • Prepare solution presentations
  • Ability to work well in a team
  • Excellent problem-solving skills
  • Good communication

title: Client Account Manager (CAM) - Trading
description:
About This Critical Role:


Are you passionate about financial markets and client success? We're looking for a dedicated Client Account Manager to serve as the guardian of our clients' trading operations. This hands-on position puts you at the center of daily trading activities, ensuring our algorithmic systems perform flawlessly for every client.



Your Daily Impact:


- Market Open Preparation (Pre-9:30 AM EST):

- Execute morning startup procedures across all client VPS environments

- Verify trading account connectivity and algorithm activation

- Document market conditions and system status in real-time tracking sheets

- Ensure clients are positioned for optimal trading from market open



Active Market Monitoring:


- Conduct hourly wellness checks on all client accounts

- Proactively identify and resolve connectivity or performance issues

- Maintain constant vigilance over algorithmic trading performance

- Provide immediate troubleshooting and escalation when needed



End-of-Day Excellence:


- Execute proper market close procedures for all accounts

- Generate personalized daily performance reports for each client

- Deliver professional updates via Discord summarizing trading results

- Prepare systems for the next trading session



Location:


We are specifically seeking candidates based in Colombia, Argentina, Costa Rica, Brazil, and Mexico . If you're located in Latin America and have availability during U.S. market hours, we encourage you to apply.


If you have daytrading experience , even better - it's not required, but it will give you a significant advantage in this role.



Ideal Candidate Profile:


Core Requirements:


- Professional-grade internet connection and reliable computer setup

- Availability during U.S. market hours (9:30 AM – 4:00 PM EST)

- Exceptional attention to detail with zero-tolerance for errors

- Strong written communication skills for client reporting

- Ability to work independently while maintaining high standards



Valuable Assets:


- Experience with VPS environments or remote desktop management

- Knowledge of NinjaTrader or similar trading platforms

- Background in financial markets or trading operations

- Previous client-facing or account management experience



What We Offer:


- Market-Hours Focus: Work during active trading hours with evenings free

- Client Impact: Directly contribute to client success and satisfaction

- Professional Development: Gain deep experience in algorithmic trading operations

- Comprehensive Support: Complete training program with ongoing mentorship

- Competitive Package: $2,500/month with performance-based growth opportunities

- Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere with reliable internet



Ready to Make an Impact?


If you're detail-oriented, technically capable, and excited about playing a crucial role in our clients' trading success, we want to hear from you. Join our team and help shape the future of algorithmic trading at Vincere Trading.


Please make a 5 minute loom video going over your trading and Client Account Management experience and why you would be a good fit for this role, and email it to: Thank you!

title: Crypto Venture Analyst
description:
Crypto Venture Analyst

Company: Meta Martian

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Department: Investment & Research

Compensation Strategy

Salary Range: $70,000 – $100,000 USD / year We pay in USD or USDC. This compensation package is explicitly benchmarked to the top 1% of the Brazilian venture capital market. We believe in rewarding high-conviction insights, not just hours worked.

The Investment Mandate and Regional Focus

Meta Martian is deploying capital into the builders who are re-architecting the internet. We are seeking a Crypto Venture Analyst based in Brazil to act as our eyes and ears in the LATAM market-one of the fastest-growing crypto adoption zones in the world. Your mandate is to identify high-signal opportunities before they hit the mainstream radar. You are not here to follow the herd; you are here to build the thesis that the herd will eventually follow. You will be dissecting early-stage protocols, connecting with founders in São Paulo, Rio, and Buenos Aires, and feeding high-quality deal flow into our global investment committee.

Due Diligence and Deal Flow Mechanics

This role is the engine of our decision-making process. You will lead the rigorous \"under the hood\" inspection of potential investments. This goes far beyond reading a pitch deck. We expect you to scrutinize the technical architecture, challenge the founders on their go-to-market assumptions, and verify the integrity of their team. You will manage the entire deal funnel: from the first coffee meeting with a founder to writing the final Investment Memo that convinces our partners to sign a check. You must be comfortable asking uncomfortable questions to protect our capital.

Thesis Generation and Tokenomics Forensics

We do not invest in \"vibes.\" We invest in sustainable mechanics. A core part of your role is Tokenomic Stress-Testing . You will take a project's proposed token distribution and model it out over 5 years. You must answer critical questions: Does the token capture value? Is the inflation schedule predatory? Is the FDV (Fully Diluted Valuation) realistic compared to competitors? You will produce deep-dive sector research-whether on DePIN, Zero-Knowledge proofs, or RWA-that shapes our firm's view on where the market is heading over the next cycle.

What We Are Not Looking For (The Anti-Persona)

To respect your time, let us define what this role is not :

  • Not a \"Spray and Pray\" Investor: We are a high-conviction fund. If you like throwing small checks at every meme coin, this is not for you.
  • Not a Passive Observer: If you wait for deals to come to your inbox, you will fail. We need a hunter who is active in the developer trenches.
  • Not a Chart Watcher: This is a Venture Capital role (Seed/Series A), not a liquid hedge fund role. We do not care about daily price action; we care about multi-year technology horizons.
The Analyst Archetype
  • You are deeply embedded in the crypto culture. You likely have a \"degen\" past but a professional present. You are fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a plus). You have a network of developers and builders in Brazil who trust you. You are intellectually honest-you are willing to kill your own favorite deal if the data shows it is a bad investment. You combine the networking skills of a BD manager with the analytical rigor of a mathematician.

  • Not a Passive Observer: If you wait for deals to come to your inbox, you will fail. We need a hunter who is active in the developer trenches.
  • Not a Chart Watcher: This is a Venture Capital role (Seed/Series A), not a liquid hedge fund role. We do not care about daily price action; we care about multi-year technology horizons.
The Analyst Archetype
  • You are deeply embedded in the crypto culture. You likely have a \"degen\" past but a professional present. You are fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a plus). You have a network of developers and builders in Brazil who trust you. You are intellectually honest-you are willing to kill your own favorite deal if the data shows it is a bad investment. You combine the networking skills of a BD manager with the analytical rigor of a mathematician.

title: Tech Lead
description:
Descrição da vaga

A Verity está buscando novos talentos!


Somos uma aceleradora de soluções digitais e buscamos Tech Lead para fazer parte dessa jornada.


Olha só quais são as experiências e conhecimentos que você precisa ter para acelerar e transformar com a gente:

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Definir, sustentar e evoluir a arquitetura base dos agentes de IA, garantindo coerência técnica, escalabilidade e aderência às necessidades do negócio.


Atuar de forma hands-on, liderando pelo exemplo e assegurando que as soluções funcionem de maneira lógica, eficiente e sustentável.



Responsabilidades Principais


Desenhar a arquitetura técnica dos agentes, incluindo fluxos de orquestração, memória, integrações e camadas de decisão.


Garantir o correto funcionamento lógico dos agentes, desde a concepção até a execução em produção.


Aplicar arquiteturas de agentes baseadas em MCP (Model Context Protocol), garantindo modularidade e padronização ou A2A.


Implementar, evoluir e refatorar componentes técnicos de IA de forma contínua.

Desenvolver soluções em Python, atuando diretamente no código dos agentes.


Construir e manter fluxos utilizando LangChain e LangGraph para orquestração e controle de estados.


Implementar e gerenciar bancos de dados vetorizados para busca semântica, memória e recuperação de contexto.


Atuar em integrações, testes, validações técnicas e troubleshooting.



Integração com SAP e Times Técnicos


Trabalhar de forma integrada com a equipe técnica de SAP para viabilizar os agentes de IA.


Entender os fluxos, dados e restrições do ecossistema SAP.


Desenhar soluções de agentes alinhadas aos processos SAP, garantindo viabilidade técnica e aderência ao contexto do cliente.


Atuar como ponte técnica entre IA e SAP, assegurando integração consistente e sustentável.



Qualidade, Padrões e Governança


Definir padrões técnicos, boas práticas e guidelines para desenvolvimento de agentes de IA.


Garantir qualidade, segurança, performance e observabilidade das soluções.


Assegurar que a arquitetura seja escalável, reutilizável e preparada para evolução.

title: Microsoft Dynamics Developer
description:
About You

You are a technically strong Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations Developer who enjoys building, customizing, and integrating enterprise-grade ERP solutions. You thrive in structured environments, value best practices, and take ownership of delivering reliable, well-documented systems. You collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and feel comfortable supporting, maintaining, and evolving complex business applications.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).
  • Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations Apps Developer Associate (mandatory and up to date, with annual renewal).
  • Strong experience developing and customizing Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O) solutions.
  • Solid understanding of D365 F&O architecture, development lifecycle, and best practices.
  • Proven experience designing and maintaining integrations using Azure Data Factory for ETL and data synchronization.
  • Hands-on experience using Microsoft Lifecycle Services (LCS) for deployment, monitoring, environment management, and maintenance.
  • Ability to collaborate with functional and technical stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills for production and non-production environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Develop, customize, and maintain Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations applications based on business requirements.
  • Design, build, and support data integrations using Azure Data Factory, ensuring data accuracy and reliability.
  • Use Microsoft Lifecycle Services (LCS) to manage deployments, monitor environments, and support application health.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (functional consultants, developers, business users) to deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to development standards and best practices.
  • Provide technical support, troubleshooting, and issue resolution for D365 F&O applications.
  • Document technical designs, configurations, integrations, and operational processes.
  • Support ongoing maintenance, optimization, and continuous improvement of D365 F&O solutions.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: SAP S/4HANA Business Systems Analyst – (E-invoice)
description:
We are seeking an experienced SAP S/4HANA Business Systems Analyst to expand our E-invoice integrations offering.


Job responsibilities/ Role Requirements include:

• Provide subject matter expertise on tax determination, reporting and compliance (including e-invoicing)

• Perform detailed analysis, feasibility, and integration design of business processes within SAP S/4HANA modules (MM, SD, and FI) to the integration

• Assist in project management, implementation planning and test approach / planning

• Solid understanding of tax data flow between organizational systems, technical architecture, integrations, and data pipelines between ERP and Tax/ compliance systems.

• Excellent communication skills and ability to work cross functionally with other Functional Consultants, Developers/ Architects, Sales, Professional Services, Customer Support, Tax Research, Customers and Prospects

• Prepare detailed Functional Specification documentation with use cases, PowerPoint presentations, and other documents to explain requirements internally and externally.

• Support the product development process, working closely with Development, QA and Documentation teams throughout the whole product life cycle, feature validating functionality, as well as preparing the rest of the organization for product release.

• Assist with end-user documentation, process flows, specifications, and diagrams to provide direction to customers, partners and professional services, and support teams.

• Support product rollouts and implementations as domain expert and/or primary business interface to other parties.

• Follow product into the field to ensure customer success, providing business and data integration expertise to customers, partners and internal professional services personnel as needed.

• Assist in providing 2nd level support and training to Customer Support, Professional Services, and integration partners.

• Provide business expertise in sales calls as needed.


Qualifications

• Working experience in SAP localization requirements

• Working experience in Indirect Tax Compliance and E- Invoicing

• Experience in SAP S/4HANA configuration and implementation (FI, SD or MM) and Strong knowledge in various SAP business processes in FI, SD and MM and cross module integrations.


We are digital changemakers – here to disrupt old ideas, blaze new trails, and help enterprises transform and scale at unparalleled speed.

title: LLM – Business Analyst
description:
Job Description: LLM – Business Analyst

Role Type: Short-Term Contract (2 months)

Location: Remote – Colombia


Commitment: Full-time (40 hours/week, 8 hours/day) with 4–5 hours overlap with PST


About the Role

We are seeking detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning . This role is ideal for professionals with strong analytical skills, familiarity with digital tools, and experience in evaluation or QA-type work.

Responsibilities

  • Perform side-by-side evaluations, comparing outputs for quality and accuracy.
  • Conduct fact-checking and identify inconsistencies.
  • Provide clear justifications for evaluation decisions.
  • Use browser-based tools and extensions for analysis.
  • Execute simple command-line instructions when required.
  • Document findings and communicate insights.

Requirements

  • Strong computer skills in a professional setting.
  • Experience with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Analytical and critical thinking skills with high attention to detail.
  • Good written communication skills in English.
  • Must be based in Argentina, Mexico, Peru, Brazil, Chile, or Colombia .

Nice to Have

  • Experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.
  • Familiarity with data quality or model/output assessments.
  • Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.

title: Crypto Market Maker
description:
Crypto Market Maker Company: Meta Martian Location: Brazil (Remote) Department: Algorithmic Trading and Liquidity

Compensation Strategy

Salary Range: $100,000 – $140,000 USD per year plus Performance Bonus We pay in USD or USDC. This base salary is benchmarked significantly above the local Brazilian market rate for quantitative finance roles. We expect world-class execution and we pay accordingly.

The Mission and Market Function

At Meta Martian , we provide the liquidity that keeps the crypto economy moving. We are seeking a Crypto Market Maker to manage our proprietary trading strategies on both Centralized (CEX) and Decentralized (DEX) exchanges. Your mission is not to predict the future price of Bitcoin. Your mission is to ensure that our order books are deep, our spreads are tight, and our inventory is balanced. You are the architect of market efficiency.

The Scope of Execution

Your primary mandate is the management of our automated trading systems. You will oversee a portfolio of market-making algorithms that quote bid and ask orders 24 hours a day. You must constantly adjust the parameters of these bots based on market volatility. When the market is calm, you capture the spread. When the market crashes, you manage the risk to ensure we do not end up holding \"toxic flow.\" You are responsible for the daily Profit and Loss (PnL) of your assigned pairs.

Operational Responsibility and Tooling

This role requires a hybrid of trading intuition and engineering skill. You will spend your day in Python . You will write scripts to analyze trade history and optimize our quoting logic. You will connect to Exchange APIs via WebSocket to monitor latency and order rejection rates. You will work closely with our quant developers to improve our execution infrastructure, but you must be capable of fixing a broken script yourself in the middle of the night if necessary.

Negative Scope

To ensure we are aligned, please note the following:

  • Not a Discretionary Trader: You will not be manually buying or selling assets based on technical analysis patterns or news sentiment. You manage systems, not individual trades.
  • Not a Blockchain Developer: You do not need to write Smart Contracts in Solidity. You need to understand market microstructure and exchange connectivity.
  • Not an Entry-Level Role: We cannot train you on the basics of an Order Book or how an AMM works. You must arrive with this knowledge fully formed.
The Trader Archetype

We are looking for a candidate with a background in Mathematics, Physics, or Computer Science . You have professional experience in high-frequency trading (HFT) or electronic market making, either in crypto or traditional finance (B3/BM&F). You are comfortable handling large notional values and stay calm when volatility spikes. You understand that in market making, risk management is more important than profit maximization.

title: Engenheiro de dados - Líder Técnico
description:
A VMBears é uma empresa jovem e moderna com o objetivo de ajudar seus clientes a aproveitar novas tecnologias para acelerar seus negócios. Fornece serviços de consultoria para arquitetura corporativa e modernização de sistemas para nuvem. Fundada em 2018, possui em seu DNA a ética, a positividade, o comprometimento e a inovação. Somos focados em oferecer os melhores serviços prestados através dos melhores profissionais do mercado. Esses recursos são utilizados para auxiliar os clientes em sua jornada de modernização tecnológica e transformação digital.


O que buscamos?

O Engenheiro(a) de Dados é o profissional que constrói e mantém a infraestrutura responsável por mover, transformar e disponibilizar dados com confiabilidade e performance. Um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados eficaz domina pipelines batch + streaming, otimiza consultas em data-warehouses colunares e garante a rastreabilidade ponta-a-ponta de cada registro. Na prática, atua como elo entre arquitetura e desenvolvimento, permanecendo intrinsecamente ligado(a) ao código que sustenta o fluxo de informações.


Na VMBears, o Engenheiro(a) de Dados é o(a) guardião(ã) da qualidade dos dados: projeta pipelines escaláveis, monitora sua saúde em produção e antecipa gargalos. Para este projeto, a modernização de um motor de cálculo de alto volume no setor de energia, buscamos alguém que una profundidade técnica em processamento distribuído e lakehouse a uma mentalidade de produto baseada em dados.


Você integrará o squad que modernizará o Motor de Cálculo, um engine que processa bilhões de registros, aplica centenas de fórmulas regulatórias e gera resultados contábeis que movem o mercado de energia elétrica. Procuramos alguém que combine habilidade de modelar dados massivos com espírito de colaboração, ajudando o time a migrar de um monolito PL/SQL para uma plataforma distribuída, event-driven e cloud-native, onde cada byte chegue rápido, íntegro e auditável ao novo motor.


Responsabilidades:

  • Implementar soluções com arquitetura de dados distribuída, garantindo latência e throughput que atendam aos requisitos da do negócio;
  • Implantar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e publicação que suportem batch + streaming em larga escala;
  • Desenvolver jobs Spark/Flink e para data-warehouses colunares;
  • Seguir padrões de versionamento, catalogação e lineage de dados para rastreabilidade de processamento;
  • Desenvolver processos sempre visando o menor custo e maior performance em Redshift/BigQuery/Athena, propondo ajustes de partição, compressão e caching;
  • Documentar processos e fluxos de trabalho de dados: Manter registros detalhados dos processos de dados para facilitar a manutenção e a melhoria contínua;
  • Projetar sistemas que possam crescer conforme a demanda por dados aumenta.


Stack desejável:

  • Redshift, BigQuery, Snowflake, Athena, Iceberg, Delta Lake;
  • Spark (DataFrames, Structured Streaming), Flink, EMR, Dataproc, Databricks, Hadoop (YARN, HDFS);
  • Apache NiFi, Kafka Connect, AWS DMS, Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub;
  • Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, OpenTelemetry, DataHub, Great Expectations;
  • Terraform/IaC, CI/CD Git, testes de dados automatizados, segurança LGPD (IAM fine-grained, encryption at rest/in transit).


Requisitos imprescindíveis:

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação ou área relacionada;
  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro de Dados: Ter um histórico sólido na área de engenharia de dados. Pensamento lógico e solução de problemas complexos.
  • Proficiência em alguma linguagem de programação (Python, Java e outras) e SQL: Ser capaz de usar essas linguagens de programação para manipular e gerenciar dados.
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias de big data: Familiaridade com ferramentas que permitem o processamento de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Experiência com sistemas de gerenciamento de banco de dados: Saber como projetar e manter bancos de dados eficientes. Organização para gerenciar grandes volumes de dados e processos críticos.
  • Habilidades de resolução de problemas e pensamento analítico: Capacidade de identificar e resolver problemas complexos de dados. Habilidade de documentação e boas práticas em arquitetura de dados.


Segue abaixo os benefícios oferecidos:

  • Auxílio home-office;
  • Nossa forma de trabalho é totalmente home-office permitindo que você esteja sempre perto de quem mais importa;
  • Descontos em academias através do Total Pass;
  • Desenvolvimento profissional aqui é primordial, por isso oferecemos um programa de capacitação online onde você recebe R$300,00 de crédito semestralmente para adquirir cursos na plataforma Udemy;
  • Quer se certificar em algum skill que se faz necessário para sua atuação profissional? Reembolsamos suas certificações!
  • Gosta de trabalhar aqui? Então indique um amigo ou parente! Nosso programa de indicação de novos Bears oferece R$2.000,00 por pessoa que permaneça conosco por mais de 3 meses.

title: Engenheiro de dados - Líder Técnico
description:
A VMBears é uma empresa jovem e moderna com o objetivo de ajudar seus clientes a aproveitar novas tecnologias para acelerar seus negócios. Fornece serviços de consultoria para arquitetura corporativa e modernização de sistemas para nuvem. Fundada em 2018, possui em seu DNA a ética, a positividade, o comprometimento e a inovação. Somos focados em oferecer os melhores serviços prestados através dos melhores profissionais do mercado. Esses recursos são utilizados para auxiliar os clientes em sua jornada de modernização tecnológica e transformação digital.


O que buscamos?

O Engenheiro(a) de Dados é o profissional que constrói e mantém a infraestrutura responsável por mover, transformar e disponibilizar dados com confiabilidade e performance. Um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados eficaz domina pipelines batch + streaming, otimiza consultas em data-warehouses colunares e garante a rastreabilidade ponta-a-ponta de cada registro. Na prática, atua como elo entre arquitetura e desenvolvimento, permanecendo intrinsecamente ligado(a) ao código que sustenta o fluxo de informações.


Na VMBears, o Engenheiro(a) de Dados é o(a) guardião(ã) da qualidade dos dados: projeta pipelines escaláveis, monitora sua saúde em produção e antecipa gargalos. Para este projeto, a modernização de um motor de cálculo de alto volume no setor de energia, buscamos alguém que una profundidade técnica em processamento distribuído e lakehouse a uma mentalidade de produto baseada em dados.


Você integrará o squad que modernizará o Motor de Cálculo, um engine que processa bilhões de registros, aplica centenas de fórmulas regulatórias e gera resultados contábeis que movem o mercado de energia elétrica. Procuramos alguém que combine habilidade de modelar dados massivos com espírito de colaboração, ajudando o time a migrar de um monolito PL/SQL para uma plataforma distribuída, event-driven e cloud-native, onde cada byte chegue rápido, íntegro e auditável ao novo motor.


Responsabilidades:

  • Implementar soluções com arquitetura de dados distribuída, garantindo latência e throughput que atendam aos requisitos da do negócio;
  • Implantar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e publicação que suportem batch + streaming em larga escala;
  • Desenvolver jobs Spark/Flink e para data-warehouses colunares;
  • Seguir padrões de versionamento, catalogação e lineage de dados para rastreabilidade de processamento;
  • Desenvolver processos sempre visando o menor custo e maior performance em Redshift/BigQuery/Athena, propondo ajustes de partição, compressão e caching;
  • Documentar processos e fluxos de trabalho de dados: Manter registros detalhados dos processos de dados para facilitar a manutenção e a melhoria contínua;
  • Projetar sistemas que possam crescer conforme a demanda por dados aumenta.


Stack desejável:

  • Redshift, BigQuery, Snowflake, Athena, Iceberg, Delta Lake;
  • Spark (DataFrames, Structured Streaming), Flink, EMR, Dataproc, Databricks, Hadoop (YARN, HDFS);
  • Apache NiFi, Kafka Connect, AWS DMS, Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub;
  • Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, OpenTelemetry, DataHub, Great Expectations;
  • Terraform/IaC, CI/CD Git, testes de dados automatizados, segurança LGPD (IAM fine-grained, encryption at rest/in transit).


Requisitos imprescindíveis:

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação ou área relacionada;
  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro de Dados: Ter um histórico sólido na área de engenharia de dados. Pensamento lógico e solução de problemas complexos.
  • Proficiência em alguma linguagem de programação (Python, Java e outras) e SQL: Ser capaz de usar essas linguagens de programação para manipular e gerenciar dados.
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias de big data: Familiaridade com ferramentas que permitem o processamento de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Experiência com sistemas de gerenciamento de banco de dados: Saber como projetar e manter bancos de dados eficientes. Organização para gerenciar grandes volumes de dados e processos críticos.
  • Habilidades de resolução de problemas e pensamento analítico: Capacidade de identificar e resolver problemas complexos de dados. Habilidade de documentação e boas práticas em arquitetura de dados.


Segue abaixo os benefícios oferecidos:

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Our client is a U.S.-based company that provides technical expertise, testing, and certification services to the global food and agricultural industry. Their mission is to ensure food safety, quality, and sustainability across international supply chains.


They are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, and optimize the core APIs and data services powering their flagship SaaS platform. This role focuses requires expertise in TypeScript/JavaScript, C#/.NET and Azure cloud development practices. You will also help set technical direction, mentor other engineers, and ensure the software meets the highest standards for performance, scalability, and security.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Design and develop RESTful APIs and backend services using .NET/C# on Azure Web Apps
  • Model and manage SQL data structures (Azure SQL) to support complex engineering workflows.
  • Build responsive, accessible UI screens in HTML and TypeScript, leveraging the Webix control platform to deliver clean, maintainable front-end components
  • Implement security best practices including IAM role configuration, least-privilege access, and API authentication/authorization.
  • Write and maintain test automation to ensure code quality and reduce regression risk.
  • Participate in DevOps practices including CI/CD pipeline maintenance, infrastructure-as-code (YAML), and application monitoring using telemetry tools Application Insights and KUSTO language.
  • Leverage AI-powered assistants and developer tools to reduce repetitive work, improve code quality, and accelerate delivery.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with international teams including Product Managers, UX designers, test engineers, and DevOps.
  • Mentor team members on best practices in software architecture, design patterns, and coding standards.
  • Conduct code reviews to ensure adherence to established guidelines.


This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employees may be asked to perform additional tasks as required, that may or may not be related to their primary duties.


Required Qualifications:


  • BA/BS degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of professional experience developing SaaS applications.
  • 2+ years in .NET/C# for developing RESTful APIs.
  • 2+ years Web API, JSON, and TypeScript consuming RESTful APIs
  • Proficiency in version control tools (e.g., Git) and Agile development practices.
  • Experience with SQL databases such as SQL Server / Oracle
  • Ability to work independently in short delivery cycles with minimal rework.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture and design patterns.


This is a CRT Role at R$18,000/month + Annual Bonus

title: Executivo (a) de Vendas Jr
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:

Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas.

Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente!


Principais atividades:


  • Realizar venda e o pós-venda para laboratórios credenciados, concretizando a negociação dos contratos e providenciando a capacitação dos clientes, para atingir os resultados projetados;
  • Levantar novas oportunidades de convênio na região de atuação, realizando a venda dos serviços oferecidos pela empresa, para garantir os resultados esperados;
  • Atuar na recuperação de clientes, apurando os problemas e propondo ações para concretização de novas vendas; Realizar visitas de acompanhamento, a fim de identificar dificuldades e pontos de melhoria no atendimento ao cliente; Realizar a interface entre instituição x parceria, informando aos convênios atualização de portfólio;
  • Pesquisar como estão as ações e preços praticados pelo mercado concorrente;
  • Administrar a carteira de clientes, acompanhando o crescimento x queda de utilização dos serviços na sua área de atuação;
  • Apurar os problemas e identificar ações de recuperação de clientes, com foco na solução preventiva e corretiva; Auxiliar nas negociações financeiras com os laboratórios conveniados;
  • Apresentar os novos instrumentos de gestão ou de processo de informação dos serviços aos clientes chaves, para obter melhorias nas relações comerciais;
  • Participar de Licitações, quando necessário.



Buscamos alguém que apresente:


  • Formação Superior Completa em Biomedicina, Farmácia ou Ciências Biológicas;
  • Experiência na área comercial;
  • Experiência na área laboratorial;
  • CNH - B (habilidade na direção- será realizado teste de habilidade);
  • Disponibilidade para viagens semanais.



Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.


Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:


• Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;

• Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;

• Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;

• Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;

• Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;

• Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.


Informações da vaga:


Modelo de Trabalho: Híbrido.

Campo Grande - Mato Grosso do Sul.

Horário de Trabalho: 08h as 18h segunda a sexta-feira.


Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!


Saúde e Bem-estar:

• Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;

• Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;

• Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;

• Acesso à plataforma OrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;

• Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas;

• Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida.


Proteção e estabilidade:

• Previdência privada;

• Participação nos lucros;

title: Analista de BI
description:
Código da vaga: 57581


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Experiência anterior em projetos de Governança de Dados ou BI;

- Capacidade de mapeamento de processos e documentação (BPMN);

- Forte visão analítica e habilidade para traduzir requisitos de negócio em estruturas de dados;

- Conhecimento em gestão de metadados, glossário, linhagem e políticas de dados;

- Experiência com ferramentas de catálogo de dados (desejável: OpenMetadata);

- Conhecimento prático em SQL e Python;

- Familiaridade com ambientes AWS (S3, Glue, Redshift, IAM);

- Noções de ETL/ELT e ferramentas como dbt, Airflow ou similares;

- Conhecimento em LGPD e boas práticas de segurança da informação;


O que será um diferencial?


- Familiaridade com DAMA DMBOK;

- Conhecimento em DataOps e automação de pipelines de dados;

- Certificações ou cursos em Governança de Dados, LGPD ou AWS;

- Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum / Kanban);


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Executive Search Consultant
description:
About Gold & Aron:

Gold & Aron Conseil is a boutique executive search firm with a 20+ year track record of placing top-tier talent in the Technology and Financial Services industries across the Americas and Europe.


About the Role

We are hiring an Executive Search Senior Associate to support Gold & Aron CEO and COO across high-impact searches in Technology and Financial Services in a premium boutique environment. The role blends deep research, pipeline development, and end-to-end recruiting for select mid-level roles. You’ll help build the engine that enables leadership to focus on client strategy and firm growth.


WHAT YOU WILL DO


Candidate Research & Sourcing for senior level searches (60%)

  • Build and manage strong candidate pipelines across multiple concurrent searches.
  • Active search: Conduct structured research, market mapping using several tech tools including Linkedin, AI tools and own data base.
  • Passive search: Source, screen applicants
  • Lead candidate scoring, initial candidate assessment


End to end Recruiting for selected mid level searches (30%)

  • Build and manage candidate pipeline
  • Conduct first-round screens to assess fit and motivation.
  • Prepare concise candidate summaries and search updates.
  • Support client communications and progress check-ins.
  • Coordinate interviews and every other step of the hiring process.


Business Development Support (10%)

  • Research companies, markets, and potential clients
  • Build prospect lists and market intelligence for the CEO and COO.
  • Bring new ideas, new BD initiatives for the company


IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE

  • 3–7+ years in research, consulting, finance, tech, recruiting, or similar fields.
  • Experience in or recruiting for Tech or Financial Services is a strong plus.
  • Advanced English + Native Portuguese is a must. Spanish is a strong plus.
  • Analytical, structured thinker with strong organization and attention to detail.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity; bias for action; strong ownership mindset.
  • Bachelor’s degree mandatory.
  • Location: Brazil remote. Preference for São Paulo, SP.

title: Engenheiro de software sênior .NET
description:
Quem é Stone Tech?

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

title: Engenheiro OTM (Oracle Transportation Management)
description:
Engenheiro OTM (Oracle Transportation Management) Sr.


  • Data de Início: Imediata
  • Contrato: Longo Prazo
  • Horário de Trabalho: UTC – Sede em Dallas/TX/EUA
  • Modalidade: 100% remoto
  • Contrato de Trabalho: PJ ou via Cooperativa
  • Taxa Hora: A ser negociado


Descrição da Vaga:


Profissional responsável por projetar, implementar, manter e dar suporte às soluções Oracle Transportation Management (OTM), garantindo eficiência operacional, confiabilidade, integração com outros sistemas e aderência às melhores práticas de logística, transporte e cadeia de suprimentos. Este profissional atuará como referência técnica para o ambiente OTM, apoiando equipes de negócios, operações e técnicas.


Principais Responsabilidades:


  • Configurar, aprimorar e ajustar tecnicamente o Oracle Transportation Management.
  • Definir e implementar soluções alinhadas às estratégias de logística, transporte e distribuição.
  • Realizar análise de requisitos, desenho de processos e documentação técnica e funcional.
  • Executar troubleshooting, análise de performance e resolução de incidentes em ambientes OTM.
  • Apoiar processos de implementação, melhoria contínua e projetos de evolução.
  • Trabalhar em integrações com ERP, WMS, TMS externos e outras plataformas corporativas.
  • Garantir segurança, governança, qualidade de dados e melhores práticas de arquitetura.
  • Apoiar equipes de negócios, operações e TI no uso correto do OTM.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:


  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro OTM ou em projetos com Oracle Transportation Management.
  • Forte conhecimento nos módulos de planejamento, execução, tarifação e visibilidade de transporte.
  • Experiência em integração do OTM com outros sistemas corporativos.
  • Experiência em desenho de soluções e análise funcional de processos logísticos.
  • Experiência com troubleshooting, suporte e sustentação do OTM.
  • Conhecimento em SFTP, Web Services, APIs, XML, SQL ou tecnologias de integração relacionadas.
  • Idioma: Inglês avançado é obrigatório


Requisitos Desejáveis:


  • Experiência em ambientes logísticos de alta complexidade.
  • Conhecimento em Oracle Cloud, OCI, Oracle Cloud ERP ou plataformas relacionadas.
  • Experiência em projetos internacionais ou multiculturais.
  • Certificações Oracle ou relacionadas à cadeia de suprimentos são um diferencial.


Soft Skills:


  • Perfil analítico, organizado e orientado a soluções.
  • Forte habilidade de comunicação e capacidade de engajamento com equipes técnicas e de negócios.
  • Proatividade, capacidade de priorização e autonomia.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa em ambientes dinâmicos.
  • Mentalidade voltada a processos e foco em melhoria contínua.


Mais informações serão fornecidas na entrevista técnica.

title: UI Designer & Design Ops
description:
Modalidade: Presencial – Brasília

Regime: CLT

Carga horária: Segunda à quinta - 8h às 18h / Sexta - 8h às 17h


Estamos em busca de um(a) especialista em Interface e Design Sytem que respire Figma. Se você é aquela pessoa que organiza camadas por instinto, domina variáveis e cria protótipos de alta fidelidade que parecem um produto real, seu lugar e aqui. ❤️


O foco desta função não é Discovery (embora você possa vir ajudar com isso), mas sim a execução técnica de alto nível, garantindo que nossas entregas sejam rápidas, consistentes e prontas para o hand-off de engenharia.


Responsabilidades:

Gestão do Design System: Ser o(a) guardião(ã) da biblioteca da Ticket and Go, evoluindo componentes, tokens e documentação para garantir escalabilidade.

Prototipagem de alta performace: Criar fluxos interativos complexos com velocidade, utilizando recursos avançados do Figma para simular a experiênvia final

Refinamento de UI: Transformar conceitos e wireframes em interfaces pixel-perfect, com foco total em estética, hierarquia visual e padrões de interação.

Hand-off técnico: Colaborar diretamente com desenvolvedores para garantir que a implementação seja fiel ao design, resolvendo dúvidas sobre comportamentos de componentes e auto-layout.

Consistência Cross-Product: Garantir que toda nova funcionalidade siga rigorosamente os padrões visuais estabelecidos, evitando o \"débito técnico\" de design.

This document describes three separate positions: HR & Investigation Assistant, HR & Investigation Analyst, and HR & Investigation Specialist. Individuals are hired into one position based on qualifications and experience. CLS offers a structured internal advancement path; however, progression is performance-based and not automatic.

Ask Yourself...

1. Do you live in BRAZIL and possess advanced professional communication skills in English, both verbal and written?

2. Do you love to read, write, and analyze things?

3. Are you a detailed and accurate notetaker?

4. Can you type both fast and accurately?

5. Are you willing to invest in long-term professional growth within an organization that offers structured learning and advancement opportunities?

6. Do you seek to develop your leadership skills and build a career related to Human Resources and Labor Law?

7. Would you describe yourself as someone who has a strong eye for detail?

8. Do you have experience working independently and managing your time effectively in a home office setting?

9. Are you a curious person with an analytical mind who is engaged by analyzing complex workplace complaints and evidence in employee discrimination and harassment investigations.

10. Are you someone who thrives in environments that offer continuous change, challenge, learning, and growth opportunities?

If you answered YES to all the above questions, this may be the perfect opportunity for you to join our amazing team!

About California Labor Solutions:

California Labor Solutions (CLS) is a growing workplace investigation and human resource (HR) management company located in California, USA. CLS provides HR services, such as consulting, executive search/recruitment, and employee complaint investigations, to other organizations throughout California. We help organizations become more successful by strategically supporting them to manage their workforce and the relevant employment regulations.

Role Overview:

You will assist the Principal Workplace Investigator with:

· Preparing witness interview questions.

· Creating accurate and complete witness interview notes/summaries.

· Drafting and copywriting comprehensive workplace investigation reports utilizing analytical skills and an advanced level of organization, precision, and attention to accuracy.

· Communicating findings effectively.

· Performing other workplace investigation-related tasks efficiently.

· Supporting other HR-related projects, such as executive search/recruitment.

Regardless of your academic background, this is a unique opportunity to build your human resources career.

Qualifications & Requirements:

Assistant, Analyst, and Specialist are three separate roles. Candidates are hired into one role based on qualifications, and promotion is performance-based and not automatic.

Human Resources & Investigation ASSISTANT position:

· Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills are required.

· A minimum of 2 years of full-time professional work experience (in any field) is required. This experience must have been conducted primarily in English. Internship experience does not count.

· A minimum of 1 year of experience working in a full-time job remotely with a defined schedule from a home office is required .

· A Professional Bachelor’s Degree in any field is required.

Human Resources & Investigation ANALYST position:

· Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills are required.

· A minimum of 2 years of full-time professional human resources related work experience in English OR a minimum of 4 years of professional work experience in English (in any field) is required. (Work experience in an internship does not count.) A minimum of 1 year of experience working in a full-time job remotely with a defined schedule from a home office is required.

· A Professional Bachelor’s Degree in any field is required. A master’s degree is preferred.

· A minimum of 1 year of experience drafting employee disciplinary documents or conducting serious employee complaint investigations is preferred.

Human Resources & Investigation SPECIALIST position:

· Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills are required.

· A minimum of 5 years of full-time professional human resources related work experience conducted in English is required . (Internship experience does not count.) A minimum of one (1) year of experience working in a full-time remote job with a defined schedule from a home office is required.

· A professional bachelor’s degree in any field is required. A master’s degree is preferred.

· A minimum of 1 year of experience drafting employee disciplinary documents or conducting serious employee complaint investigations is required.

· A minimum of 1 year of experience supervising employees (not just leading) is required . Experience supervising three (3) or more employees for at least one (1) year is preferred .

Amazing Compensation, Benefits, Incentives, and Bonuses:

HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION ASSISTANT (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $3,500 BRL to $5,000 BRL million COP. The total compensation amount already includes benefits, which are valued as follows:

· Gym membership support: $105 BRL

· Private health insurance support: $265 BRL

· Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL

Starting monthly base compensation ranges between $3,500 BRL to $4,200 BRL, depending on the level and quality of your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs AND possession of both required and preferred qualifications. You may also qualify for bonuses. Please see below for a list of additional compensation opportunities. Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position. Work as a CLS HR & Investigation Assistant for a minimum of 6 months with consistently competent performance and become eligible for promotion to the HR & Investigation Analyst position.

HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION ANALYST (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $5,000 BRL to $7,700 BRL. The total compensation amount already includes benefits, which are valued as follows:

· Gym membership support: $105 BRL

· Private health insurance support: $265 BRL

· Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL

Starting monthly base compensation ranges between $5,000 BRL to $6,300 BRL, depending on the level and quality of your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs AND possession of both required and preferred qualifications. You may also qualify for bonuses. Please see below for a list of additional compensation opportunities. Every six months, you will receive a performance review and a compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until you reach the maximum compensation range for the position. Work as a CLS HR & Investigation Analyst for a minimum of 12 months with competent and consistent performance and become eligible for promotion to the Specialist position.

HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION SPECIALIST (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $7,700 BRL to $10,000 BRL. The total compensation amount already includes benefits, which are valued as follows:

· Gym membership support : $105 BRL

· Private health insurance support : $265 BRL

· Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support : $160 BRL

The starting monthly compensation is $7,700 BRL to $9,000 BRL, depending on the level and quality of your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs, as well as your ability to meet both the required and preferred qualifications for the role. You may also qualify for bonuses. Please see below for a list of additional compensation opportunities. Every six months, you will receive a performance review and a compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until you reach the maximum compensation range for the position.

Additional Compensation & High-Performance Bonus Opportunities includes:

· High-performance bonus: When you perform investigation work, every case that you complete from start to finish in accordance with CLS protocols and without major errors will earn you a bonus of $700 BRL. That is $700 BRL for the person assisting the Investigator AND another $700 BRL for the senior writer (the person co-leading the project and performing the final review). Once you become “certified” to produce accurate and complete witness interview summaries (typically within your first 3 months at CLS), the bonus increases to $1,400 BRL per investigation.

Core Hours for Operations:  

Core hours of operation are Monday through Friday from 6:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. PST / 7:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. PDT, California, USA time, with the potential to earn extra pay for extended hours or weekend contributions for high-impact projects.

Core hours of operation are Monday through Friday from 6:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. PST / 7:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. PDT, California, USA time, with the potential to earn extra pay for extended hours or weekend contributions for high-impact projects.

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.

If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:

  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Account Manager
description:
Senior Account Manager – LATAM (International Contract | Remote)


Company: B2Hive Ltd.

Website:


Work Model: 100% Remote

Contract Type: International Contractor

Industry: Fintech | iGaming | Trading Platforms | Affiliate Marketing

Region: Latin America


About B2Hive


B2Hive Ltd. is a global technology provider specialized in White Label trading platforms for the digital financial market, with a strong focus on binary options and high-performance brokerage solutions . With strategic offices in Dubai (UAE), Limassol (Cyprus) and Seychelles , B2Hive operates in 30+ countries , delivering scalable technology, robust infrastructure and full operational support for brokers operating internationally.

Our solutions include:


  • High-performance trading platforms
  • Advanced backoffice and management systems
  • Global payment integrations
  • Affiliate and marketing modules
  • 24/7 specialized operational support


In 2026 , B2Hive launched a strategic expansion plan focused on Latin America , driven by the rapid growth of digital experts, influencers and affiliate ecosystems across the region.


Role Overview


We are hiring a Senior Account Manager to lead business development, sales and strategic account management of White Label brokerage solutions in LATAM. This is a senior, autonomous and results-driven position , focused on market development, high-ticket B2B sales and long-term client growth. The professional will act as the primary relationship owner between B2Hive and its brokers, combining commercial execution, account management and market intelligence.


Scope of the Position


Senior Account Manager – Brazil Market

  • Focus on business development and account management within the Brazilian market
  • Professional proficiency in Portuguese required (C1 level or higher)
  • Demonstrated experience and professional network related to the Brazilian digital finance ecosystem


Senior Account Manager – LATAM Markets

  • Focus on Latin American markets
  • Professional proficiency in Spanish required (C1 level or higher)
  • Strong experience working with LATAM markets and regional business dynamics


Key Responsibilities


Business Development & Sales

  • Prospect, negotiate and close new White Label brokerage contracts
  • Conduct consultative B2B sales for high-value solutions
  • Manage the full commercial cycle: discovery → proposal → negotiation → closing
  • Leverage existing professional relationships to generate new opportunities
  • Represent B2Hive in negotiations with decision-makers and strategic partners


Account Management & Growth

  • Act as the main point of contact for assigned broker accounts
  • Support clients throughout their operational lifecycle
  • Work closely with internal teams (operations, marketing and support)
  • Drive broker performance, volume growth, retention and longevity


A relevant portion of compensation is directly tied to client performance, making post-sale account management a core responsibility.


Market Representation & Intelligence

  • Represent B2Hive at industry events, conferences and trade fairs
  • Expand institutional and commercial relationships
  • Identify partnership opportunities and acquisition channels
  • Monitor competitors, market movements and regulatory trends
  • Proactively suggest improvements to products, strategy and positioning


Pipeline & Reporting

  • Manage pipeline, forecasts and revenue predictability
  • Report results in a structured and data-driven manner
  • Operate with ownership mindset, efficiency and financial accountability
Required Qualifications


  • Minimum 2 years of proven experience in one or more of the following sectors: iGaming / Binary Options / Forex / Affiliate Marketing
  • Demonstrated experience in B2B sales, partnerships or affiliate management
  • Active professional network involving: Influencers, Digital experts, Affiliates, Brokers or betting operators
  • Proven ability to close high-value commercial deals
  • Experience working with international contracts and cross-border operations
  • High level of autonomy and strong results orientation
  • Availability to travel and attend strategic industry events


Professional Profile


  • Ownership mentality and strategic thinking
  • Strong self-management, discipline and organization
  • Clear, professional and persuasive communication
  • High networking and relationship-building capability
  • Emotional resilience and consistency in performance
  • Strong focus on efficiency, impact and revenue generation
Compensation Structure


  • Monthly fixed fee: USD 800 – USD 1,500 (based on seniority and profile alignment)
  • Sales commission: 10% per White Label platform sold
  • Recurring performance commission: 10% over operational results of active broker accounts


This model offers scalable and recurring earning potential , directly linked to client success and regional market expansion.

Application


This is a strategic position within B2Hive’s Latin America expansion plan, designed for professionals with established market experience and a strong commercial track record. If your profile aligns with this opportunity, please apply via LinkedIn or share your contact email and phone number so our recruitment team can initiate the interview process.

  • Focus on business development and account management within the Brazilian market
  • Professional proficiency in Portuguese required (C1 level or higher)
  • Demonstrated experience and professional network related to the Brazilian digital finance ecosystem


Senior Account Manager – LATAM Markets

  • Focus on Latin American markets
  • Professional proficiency in Spanish required (C1 level or higher)
  • Strong experience working with LATAM markets and regional business dynamics


Key Responsibilities


Business Development & Sales

  • Prospect, negotiate and close new White Label brokerage contracts
  • Conduct consultative B2B sales for high-value solutions
  • Manage the full commercial cycle: discovery → proposal → negotiation → closing
  • Leverage existing professional relationships to generate new opportunities
  • Represent B2Hive in negotiations with decision-makers and strategic partners


Account Management & Growth

  • Act as the main point of contact for assigned broker accounts
  • Support clients throughout their operational lifecycle
  • Work closely with internal teams (operations, marketing and support)
  • Drive broker performance, volume growth, retention and longevity


A relevant portion of compensation is directly tied to client performance, making post-sale account management a core responsibility.


Market Representation & Intelligence

  • Represent B2Hive at industry events, conferences and trade fairs
  • Expand institutional and commercial relationships
  • Identify partnership opportunities and acquisition channels
  • Monitor competitors, market movements and regulatory trends
  • Proactively suggest improvements to products, strategy and positioning


Pipeline & Reporting

  • Manage pipeline, forecasts and revenue predictability
  • Report results in a structured and data-driven manner
  • Operate with ownership mindset, efficiency and financial accountability
Required Qualifications


  • Minimum 2 years of proven experience in one or more of the following sectors: iGaming / Binary Options / Forex / Affiliate Marketing
  • Demonstrated experience in B2B sales, partnerships or affiliate management
  • Active professional network involving: Influencers, Digital experts, Affiliates, Brokers or betting operators
  • Proven ability to close high-value commercial deals
  • Experience working with international contracts and cross-border operations
  • High level of autonomy and strong results orientation
  • Availability to travel and attend strategic industry events


Professional Profile


  • Ownership mentality and strategic thinking
  • Strong self-management, discipline and organization
  • Clear, professional and persuasive communication
  • High networking and relationship-building capability
  • Emotional resilience and consistency in performance
  • Strong focus on efficiency, impact and revenue generation
Compensation Structure


  • Monthly fixed fee: USD 800 – USD 1,500 (based on seniority and profile alignment)

  • Recurring performance commission: 10% over operational results of active broker accounts

title: Analista de compras
description:
A Berwanger Soluções é referência no segmento de içamento e movimentação de cargas, atuando em todo o Brasil com soluções eficientes e seguras para indústrias dos ramos metalmecânico, agrícola, de implementos rodoviários, metalúrgico e siderúrgico.

Buscamos um(a) Analista de Compras para atuar de forma estratégica e analítica, garantindo o abastecimento eficiente dos insumos produtivos e administrativos, com forte atuação em negociação, gestão de fornecedores, análise de custos e controle dos processos de compras.


Principais Atividades


  • Analisar e conduzir o processo de aquisição de insumos produtivos e administrativos , assegurando atendimento às demandas da fábrica e dos setores internos;


  • Realizar análises comparativas de cotações, negociações de preços, prazos, condições comerciais, fretes e transportes, visando competitividade e confiabilidade nas entregas;


  • Gerir o relacionamento com fornecedores, analisando qualidade, prazos e condições comerciais;


  • Prospectar, homologar e desenvolver novos fornecedores,


  • Monitorar e controlar o processo de compras, desde a solicitação até a entrega final de materiais e serviços , garantindo conformidade com prazos, custos e especificações;


  • Analisar preços, custos e condições dos itens aplicados em projetos, assegurando aderência técnica, viabilidade econômica e suporte à tomada de decisão;


  • Apoiar ações de melhoria contínua, redução de custos e otimização dos processos de compras.


Requisitos


  • Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Administração, Gestão de Suprimentos, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas correlatas;


  • Experiência anterior como Analista de Compras, preferencialmente em ambiente industrial;


  • Vivência com compras de insumos produtivos e administrativos, negociações, análise de custos e acompanhamento de pedidos;


  • Conhecimento intermediário em Pacote Office (principalmente Excel).


Competências


  • Perfil analítico, organizado;
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade de negociação;
  • Senso de urgência,
  • Capacidade de relacionamento e trabalho em equipe.


Benefícios



  • Vale-transporte
  • Vale-refeição
  • Cozinha para refeições
  • Assistência médica e odontológica
  • Prêmio assiduidade
  • Seguro de vida


  • Salário a combinar
